This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzo-soprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass).
Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

Chef Chris Scott, Top Chef finalist, restaurateur, and author, welcomes Matthew into his bucolic New Jersey home for an afternoon filled with flavor, fascinating stories, and a deep dive into Chris's legendary biscuit recipe.

Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

The one and only Chef Marcela Valladolid invites Matthew for a tour of her stunning historic San Diego home and lush edible garden plus a hands-on lesson in crafting the perfect taco and a signature salsa.

Chef, restaurateur, and author Melba Wilson schools Matthew on the art of her legendary shrimp and grits; with laughter, flavor, and zero room for dessert, this visit is an unforgettable taste of Harlem's finest and most original.

Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.
Matthew heads to Beverly Hills, Calif., the pinnacle of A-list living.
Matthew visits exclusive Bel Air, home to some of the biggest stars with the deepest pockets.
Matthew tours some architecturally significant properties.
Matthew heads to Pasadena, Calif., the picture-perfect backdrop for a home like no other.

Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

Imagine stepping into a kaleidoscope, where colors, shapes, and textures collide; that's exactly what Jillian experiences as she explores the iconic Mosaic Tile House in beachy, boho Venice and the Rainbow House in the desert oasis of Palm Springs.
Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

In Franklin, Tennessee, family is at the heart of everything-and it's also at the core of The Brett Boyer Foundation's mission. Nashville designer Julie Couch transforms their headquarters to radiate the same joy and hope they bring to so many.

Interior designer Leslie Martin welcomes us into her beach cottage; from the bustling, texture-rich kitchen to the cleverly utilized living spaces, the cottage radiates a warmth that belies its modest square footage.

Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money podcast, Jeremy Schneider of Personal Finance Club explains how Trump Accounts work, who should open one, how they compare to 529 plans and custodial accounts (UGMA/UTMA), and why they may become.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money Podcast, hosts Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench sit down with Cody Berman to uncover how he achieved financial independence before age 30 and built a $5 million net worth through entrepreneurship, side hustles.
Eleven Madison Park leads the plant-based culinary revolution; Le Poisson Rouge reimagines the indie music scene; Air Company introduces the future of fuel.
Why office-to-apartment conversions are booming; infinite machine builds EV bikes for cities; inside Tribeca Immersive's AI judgment booth.
New York is known as one of the rattiest cities in America with an estimated population of close to 2 million rodents; here is how New York City rats out its rodents.
The yellow taxi cab is the quintessential New York City ride; the threat of ride-share apps and city scandal has left cab drivers to face debt.
Many things come to mind when thinking about New York, but how the city deals with its garbage is usually not one of them; here is how the city hauls away its trash.
New Yorkers create, on average, 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day that makes its way through 7,500 miles of pipes that make up the city's sewer system.
Una mujer abandona en la noche de bodas a su marido para huir con un contrabandista y desencadena una tormenta pasional.
Un hombre busca al vampiro que mató a su padre para impedir que este vuelva a la vida y lucha contra sus mujeres.
Muchas mujeres desaparecen en circunstancias misteriosas, y esto genera un clima de terror y paranoia en toda la población de la ciudad. Todas las pistas apuntan al mismo museo del horror.

Un doctor mujeriego va a casarse con Mini, una mujer extremadamente celosa. Mientras, engaña a esta con su amante África y le dice que la esperará durante su gira por Cuba. Para África, no es el doctor Pablo, sino un amigo suyo llamado Ricardo. Ambas mujeres se ven envueltas en un triángulo amoroso sin saberlo.
Un hombre se convierte en luchador y se hace llamar "Dinamita Kid" para enfrentar al experimentado Huracán Ramírez.
Un viudo, cajero de un banco, es manipulado por una mala mujer, a quien termina matando y le echa la culpa a otro.
Un anciano encuentra una mina de plata en un pueblo del oeste y se lo cuenta al comisario, quien en realidad está corrompido y es el cabecilla de una banda.
Una empresaria de modas con una enfermedad que le desfigura la cara se une a un científico loco para secuestrar mujeres jóvenes.
Santo y Blue Demon luchan contra un científico que resucita cadáveres trasplantando cerebros vivos en ellos.
Santo y Blue Demon luchan contra un científico que resucita cadáveres trasplantando cerebros vivos en ellos.
Un joven pierde en apuestas fuerte suma de dinero y su padre lo echa de su casa, después se envuelve con delincuentes.
Cuando despiden a Diana del cabaret donde trabaja, Luis la aloja desinteresadamente. Sin embargo, cuando intentan escapar de un traficante de drogas, los problemas los siguen.
Un grupo de personas que no trabaja en el mismo lugar, intenta conseguir unas placas para falsificar dinero.
Unos brujos condenan a una mujer a un destino feroz porque hizo cosas crueles para conservar su finca.

The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone.

During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch.

Filmmaker Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez) is traveling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it.

Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home.
A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.
Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

The film tells the dramatic story of three legendary French aviators and the first historic airmail flights in the Andes. It combines a tale of high adventure and excitement with cutting-edge technology, and is the fulfillment of one of Annaud's long-held dreams.
A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change.

Charismatic Southern politician Willie Stark's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana. Unfortunately for Stark, his right-hand man (Jude Law) retains the same good moral fiber he had when the men both entered the political arena.

Rick Wershe is a single father who's struggling to raise two teenagers during the height of the crack epidemic in the 1980s Detroit. Wershe sells guns illegally to make ends meet but soon attracts attention from the FBI. Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself.

For the patrons and staff at a dusty roadside diner, the day begins as usual, but when the phones go out and a sweet old lady goes on the attack, it's a harbinger of the terror to come. As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it.

Semi-retired Michigan lawyer Paul Biegler (James Stewart) takes the case of Army Lt. Manion (Ben Gazzara), who murdered a local innkeeper after his wife (Lee Remick) claimed that he raped her. Over the course of an extensive trial, Biegler parries with District Attorney Lodwick (Brooks West) and out-of-town prosecutor Claude Dancer (George C. Scott) to set his client free, but his case rests on the victim's mysterious business partner (Kathryn Grant), who's hiding a dark secret.

A police officer seems to have committed suicide, but Detective Dave Bannion thinks there's more to the story. After talking to the man's mob-connected mistress, Bannion discovers far-reaching corruption that leads all the way from the police station to kingpin Mike Lagana. But when the policeman's lover is killed, it becomes clear that crossing Lagana is a dangerous thing to do. Soon Bannion finds himself marked for death and his family in mortal danger.

On a quest for world domination, Julian Wall (Karl Malden) and his evil cohorts in the Brotherhood of International Government and Order kidnap Dr. Solaris (Richard Eastham). Solaris invented a heliobeam, a weapon capable of cataclysmic destruction. It's up to secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) to rescue Solaris before he is brainwashed into using the heliobeam. Helm poses as a gangster, seducing Solaris' daughter, Suzie (Ann-Margret), along the way.

Sailors Joe (Dick Haymes) and Skip (Ray McDonald) habitually take advantage of their shipmate, Moby (Mickey Rooney), who's robbed after they take him to a shady bar. When they have no money to go to Catalina Island, Calif., Joe arranges their travel by volunteering the clueless Moby to work on the ship. Skip later meets a glamorous dancer (Peggy Ryan), while Joe woos a nightclub owner (Jody Lawrance). Moby decides to leave, but finds himself coming to the rescue of a beautiful heiress.

In this suspenseful comedy, Nancy Troy (Loretta Young) and her mystery-author husband, Jeff (Brian Aherne), move into a dark basement apartment in New York City's Greenwich Village, in hopes of stirring up writing inspiration. When their neighbors begin acting oddly and one of them turns up dead, Nancy and Jeff must uncover a murder mystery in their own building, with a number of suspects lurking about, including the creepy Mrs. Devoe (Gale Sondergaard).

In this film adaptation of the classic Shakespeare play, Grumio and Hortensio both long to wed the same beautiful young woman. Unfortunately, her wealthy father will not let his daughter marry unless her hot-tempered sister, Katharina, also has a suitor. Luckily, the slovenly Petruchio is looking for an affluent woman to marry, so Grumio and Hortensio pay him to try to woo the extremely volatile Katharina.

Set in the Libyan desert in 1942 where a group of American soldiers become isolated in their tank during the retreat to El Alamein. As they drive across the desert they pick up a group of Allied stragglers, but with their supplies of fuel, food and water running low, they try to reach a desert fortress, but a large German detachment is also heading there.

Stand-up comic Mickey One (Warren Beatty) is fearful that the gambling debts he amassed have made him a marked man in the Detroit clubs that he frequents. Assuming a false identity, Mickey flees to Chicago, where he cautiously resumes his career at the upscale Club Xanadu. When club owner Ed Castle (Hurd Hatfield) offers Mickey a shot at auditioning for an unknown man with reputed connections in the Midwest, the increasingly paranoid Mickey fears that the mob has finally closed in on him.

Veteran secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) is living a life of luxury when his former lover, Tina Batori (Daliah Lavi), pulls him back into action. A sinister group known as the Big O has developed a plot to start a global nuclear conflict, so the carefree, womanizing Helm must stop the scheme of mastermind Tung-Tze (Victor Buono). Joining the suave Helm on his mission is the beautiful but inept operative Gail Hendricks (Stella Stevens), along with other gorgeous ladies.

Theodora Lynn (Irene Dunne) is secretly the author of a salacious novel written under a pen name. She must hide her identity from the residents of her small, conservative Connecticut town, who disapprove of the book. When Theodora goes to New York to visit her publisher (Thurston Hall), she meets the book's cover artist, Michael Grant (Melvyn Douglas), who tries to convince her to reveal herself as the real author. When Theodora falls for Michael, she soon finds that he has secrets of his own.

Distraught when her middle-aged lover breaks a date with her, 21-year-old Toni Simmons (Goldie Hawn) attempts suicide. Impressed by her action, her lover, dentist Julian Winston (Walter Matthau) reconsiders marrying Toni, but he worries about her insistence on honesty. Having fabricated a wife and three children, Julian readily accepts when his devoted nurse, Stephanie (Ingrid Bergman), who has secretly loved Julian for years, offers to act as his wife and demand a divorce.

A lone gunslinger, Jack McCall (George Montgomery), bursts into a saloon and shoots dead the legendary Wild Bill Hickok (Douglas Kennedy). Arrested and put on trial, McCall recounts a twisted tale that paints Hickok as anything but heroic, explaining how Hickok and McCall's cousin Bat (James Seay) took over McCall's family's plantation, killed his parents and even framed him for crimes he didn't commit. McCall's cold-blooded killing of Hickok was warranted. Or was it?

The honorable Calem Ware (Randolph Scott), marshal of the Wild West boomtown of Medicine Bend, attempts to defuse the simmering tensions in his rapidly growing and increasingly violent town, as a greedy businessman (Warner Anderson) hires a sinister black-gloved gunman (Michael Pate) to take care of his problems with the marshal for good. Meanwhile, a traveling song-and-dance troupe arrives in town, bearing Ware's lost love, Tally (Angela Lansbury), who holds the secret to his violent past.

When solitary cowboy Jefferson Cody (Randolph Scott) hears tales of a white woman living as a captive of the Comanche tribe, he rides deep into the tribe's territory to exchange goods for her freedom. As Cody escorts the captive woman away, he learns that she is Nancy Lowe (Nancy Gates), and that there is a sizable reward offered by her husband for her return. Cody and Mrs. Lowe must brave ruthless bounty hunters greedy for the reward, as well as the now-warring Comanches, to make it to safety.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
Wild Bill Saunders comes home to help his father deal with troublesome ranchers.

Jed Cooper (Victor Mature), a trapper, enlists as an army fort scout, and shortly after meets and falls for Corinna Marston (Anne Bancroft), the wife of a nearby fort's commander. Jed comes across her husband, Col. Marston (Robert Preston), after he's suffered an attack at the hands of Native Americans. Col. Marston forces the captain of Jed's fort, Glenn Riordan (Guy Madison), to send out Jed and the troops to fight his attackers, despite their lack of battle experience.

In Texas, gunfighter Brazos Kane (Randolph Scott) decides to lay down his guns for good and rides out to visit his best friend -- only to witness his murder. When Brazos takes the body to the nearby ranch of the powerful Banner (Griff Barnett), the rancher accuses him of the murder. Brazos leaves Banner's daughter, Bess (Barbara Britton), a vital piece of evidence in the crime, and then must evade Banner and a crooked sheriff as he reluctantly takes up arms to prove his innocence.
A wildcatter (Faye Dunaway), her father (John Mills) and a boozing drifter (George C. Scott) defend her oil derrick in 1913 Oklahoma.
A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

Rancher John Stewart (Randolph Scott) prefers to resolve problems without falling back on violent solutions. However, fellow cattleman Wick Campbell (Richard Boone) isn't so peaceful, and he hires a team of armed mercenaries, led by ruthless Frank Scavo (Leo Gordon), to rid him of any possible competition. After narrowly surviving an attack from Scavo and his men, Stewart has little choice but to fight back in order to save both his ranch and his family, including nephew Howie (Skip Homeier).

Hell-bent on revenge, flinty gunslinger Bart Allison (Randolph Scott) rides into a sleepy Western town with one goal in mind: to kill local roughneck Tate Kimbrough (John Carroll), who kidnapped his wife years ago. Both men have blood on their hands over the woman's eventual suicide. Allison and Kimbrough, wracked with guilt but boiling over with bloodlust, are set to face off for one final confrontation. Tensions mount as sunset approaches, and the townspeople must choose sides.

Dan Evans (Van Heflin), a drought-plagued Arizona rancher, volunteers to take captured stagecoach robber and murderer Ben Wade (Glenn Ford) from Bisbee to Contention City, where the criminal will be put aboard the 3:10 train to Yuma for his trial. Accompanied only by the town drunk, Alex Potter (Henry Jones), Dan battles Wade's henchman (Richard Jaeckel), the murder victim's revenge-minded brother, and the temptation of the large bribe Wade offers in exchange for his freedom.
La vida de Sebastián se ve rodeada de pruebas cada vez más difíciles, tras morir Clarita. Pero, él cuenta con el apoyo de su familia.
Un joven que ha crecido con todas las comodidades tiene un accidente y su padre es acusado de un fraude, por lo que su vida cambiará y tendrá que buscar trabajo para sobrevivir.
Mateo y Jerónimo tratan de conquistar a la chica nueva, Azucena. Accidentalmente, Jerónimo daño a Mateo.
Sara es una joven irresponsable que empieza a vivir con su hermana mayor. Las cosas empeoran cuando conoce a su nueva vecina, Eva.
El novio de Araceli la dejó y ella está muy triste. Ella cree estar enamorada de Silvano, el amigo de su hermano.
Iñaki perdió a sus padres en un accidente aéreo. El quiere ser DJ, pero debe lidiar con la disciplina de su abuelo.
Janeth queda embarazada y acude con la doctora de su escuela en busca de ayuda. Pero su destino quedará en manos de un traficante de órganos.
Jaime está gravemente enfermo. Gabo, su hermano menor, desea acercarse a él para acompañarlo.
Un hombre se aprovecha de la confianza de una joven para robar sus diseños, ella decide defender su dignidad y luchar por lo que le pertenece.
Beto es un estudiante de teatro que está dispuesto a alcanzar sus sueños. Superará las adversidades con el apoyo de su familia.
Patricia descubre que en la empresa de Mariano explota a las mujeres que allí trabajan. Decide intervenir para detener el abuso.
The investigation into the death of a woman's husband reveals he is not the first man she married who died under suspicious circumstances.
A "48 Hours" report helps trip up a wanted fugitive who spent more than four years on the run for allegedly killing his wife and staging a kidnapping scheme.
A man charged with killing his wife maintains it was a suicide.
DNA on one of two teenage girls killed similarly on a California beach six years apart leads investigators to a suspect who worked inside the police department.

Emotions ran high in the days following the Nov. 11, 2001 attack on the U.S.; for the most part, the grief and anger brought people together but for Frank Roque, it was a motivation for killing an innocent immigrant chasing the American dream.

It takes a lot of planning and skill to pull off an armored car heist in broad daylight outside a mall on one of the busiest shopping days of the year; Timothy Ring and his crew pulled it off, but never planned on how to get away with it.

What begins as a love story between Amber Bray and Jeffrey Ayers ends in tragedy when police catch Ayers and Bray red-handed, stabbing her mother to death; examine how young love leads to such violence.

Bonny Lee Bakley had nine husbands before she met former "Baretta" star Robert Blake, and he would be her last; as she waited for Blake outside a Los Angeles restaurant, someone approached her car and shot her in the head.
Young co-pilot Andreas Lubitz intentionally crashes a German airliner into the remote French Alps, killing all 150 passengers aboard.
Texas teen Ethan Couch kills four people while drinking and driving and is sentenced only to probation.
College athlete George Huguely goes on a drinking binge which leads to a deadly encounter with his ex-girlfriend.
A Spanish court convicts 21 people for the Madrid subway train bombings, but acquits a lead suspect and six others.
Collin Ferguson walks onto a Long Island Rail Road train and fires methodically at passengers, killing six and wounding 19.
A world-renowned writer and human rights activist is shot and killed in the elevator of her Moscow apartment block.

Former Miss Georgia contestant Tara Grinstead vanished without a trace in 2005; Ryan Duke, the man arrested for her murder over a decade later, may have been manipulated into confessing by an accomplice who better fits the profile of a killer.

The prosecution claims Darrin Lopez executed Jamie Faith to be with high school sweetheart Jennifer Faith, with whom he had an online BDSM affair; the defense argues Jennifer exploited Darrin's trust and PTSD.

The confession by teenagers Alex and Derek King that they bludgeoned their father to death is called into question after the family friend who turned the boys in, Ricky Chavis, is revealed to be a pedophile who wanted Alex to himself.

David Coffin's house burned down with him in it, but it wasn't the fire that killed him, it was the bullet in his head; investigators immediately focused on Scott Davis, the estranged husband of Coffin's new girlfriend.
When the bodies of Ruby Joyner and Halima Jones were discovered beaten, strangled and shot, police turned to someone they both knew; but Lewis Joyner was nowhere to be found.
When Atlanta homemaker Sara Tokars is kidnapped, shot and killed in front of her two young children, police are baffled; the answer may lie in the home safe of her husband Fred.

A Neo-Nazi turned Islamic jihadist shoots two of his roommates after an argument; in a combative interview with journalist David Scott, Devon Arthurs, now claiming to be remorseful, attempts to explain his descent into madness.

Rebecca Keller and Keri Murphy murdered Murphy's mother after she did not approve of their high school relationship; in her first TV interview ever, Keller explains to David Scott her role in the killing and even tries to justify why she did it.
A wealthy couple are targeted for death.
A filmmaker and a former Marine work to find a woman's killer.
Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.
Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.
Mark befriends a circus advance-man suspected of robbery.

When her marshal husband is murdered, Rose Hood (Beverly Garland) slides on his holster and takes his dangerous duty. This riles local brothel madam Erica Page (Allison Hayes), so she employs Cane Miro (John Ireland), a hired gun with an axe to grind, to bring an end to Hood and her brand of justice. When Miro meets Hood, though, he is struck by her strength and beauty. Still, the passion that begins to burn between them will not prevent their inevitable showdown.
First Wages - Lucas tries to find out why Mark has taken a job as a stable boy - against his wishes.

A celebration of the frontier spirit, highlighting five of the legendary Black cowboys who helped tame the Old West; today, these heroes inspire a new generation of cowboys and ranchers who keep that spirit alive and well.
Special, Documentary, Biography, History, American history, Western
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.
An Old West poker player (Kenny Rogers) acquires a sidekick (Bruce Boxleitner) and sets out to help the son he never knew.
Bret is held hostage by a group of pirates who suspect him of being a government agent.
The wife of a friend falls in love with Bart while he is recovering at their secluded mountain cabin.
Seeking revenge for a poker game gone bad, gunslinger Doc West finds himself in the local town jail. When a battle among the townspeople breaks out, he must choose sides.
Bret becomes involved with a female deputy when he tries to track down $120,000 in buried money.
Cheyenne waits out a winter with a cattle drive.
Cheyenne and Hoot Hollister take the river boat to St. Louis for a night on the town.
Lucas subdues a gang of bandits singlehandedly.

In 1887, Hunter Braddock moves back to Far Haven, Ariz., to start over with his two young children. When his father-in-law is brutally attacked, he must take on the corrupt forces strangling the town to protect what he loves most.
The team investigates a murder at a zombie convention; after revealing that she never graduated from high school, Angela decides to pursue her GED.
A 911 operator pretends to be the fiancée of an amnesiac who's actually a killer on the run.
Pushed to the breaking point, an abused woman (Kim Basinger) turns the tables on the gang of thugs who want to beat and rape her.
A hooker (Cassandra Scerbo) assumes the identity of a runaway who was killed by the hooker's pimp and retreats to the dead girl's hometown.
A popular radio preacher and author (JR Bourne) tries to keep his less-than-perfect home life under wraps, but his life begins to implode with the discovery of a son from a brief extramarital affair.
Smitten with her new employee (Jon Cor), a woman (Adrienne Frantz) uses the Internet to impersonate his long-distance girlfriend (Ashley Leggat) and destroy their relationship.
A woman (Italia Ricci) tries to help her sister (Magda Apanowicz) remember the events surrounding the stabbing death of their mother.

After Sara helps Abby, her birth mother, get released from prison, she finds herself in danger when Abby reconnects with her old partner. When he ends up dead, both Abby and Sara are hunted by the police and the dead man's partners.
A 12-year-old girl becomes jealous when her adoptive father develops a budding relationship with a woman and her teenage son.
When a mailman is killed, the team must work with an eccentric Postal Inspector; Maura continues to struggle with the ramifications of her injury; Korsak gets Kiki a terrible birthday present.
A wealthy woman is found dead at the bottom of her stairs; Maura decides to undergo minor surgery; Maura reconnects with Hope.
Jane and Maura must unravel an old ghost story to solve a double murder at a hospital; Angela convinces Frankie to stop avoiding Kent.
When a bicyclist appears to spontaneously combust, Maura proves his death is actually a murder; Jane is invited to teach a class of FBI recruits at Quantico.
Jane goes undercover in a county jail to draw out a killer who committed a brutal murder.
On the morning that Jane is supposed to testify in a murder trial, she discovers that a key piece of evidence has been stolen; Frankie decides to learn some magic tricks to impress Nina.

The lives of the Swartz parents come to an end when one of their adoptive sons unexpectedly goes on a homicidal rampage; two teenage siblings seek revenge by going on a brutal killing spree in a Nevada trailer park.
A girl goes missing, and the perpetrator turns out to be a 15-year-old thrill killer; a teenager poisons her grandmother with no apparent reason.
Stories of children killing a family member.
An entire family is shot to death as they sleep; evidence points to a teenage serial killer in the making.
A teenage boy commits a double homicide and claims that a demon told him to do it; a teenage girl starts dating a boy who is obsessed with becoming a serial killer.

When firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled to be arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide; a serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit, but it takes a dogged cold-case detective to track down the real killer.

In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Okla.; DNA evidence points to her killer over a decade later and leads to the buried bodies of two other missing women in Texas.

When 23-year-old Tonya McKinley is found brutally murdered on New Year's Day 1985, a boy is left motherless; a family waits 35 years for advancements in forensic science to finally catch a killer using familial DNA.

When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and a mother goes on a decadeslong crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Mich., wonder who would murder this pillar of the community; it will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

When 37-year-old Lee Rotatori is found dead in her hotel room in 1982 with a single stab wound to the heart, police suspect the work of a professional; it takes four decades to identify her killer and, in the process, reveal a shocking truth.

When 9-year-old Campfire Girl, Candy Rogers, turns up dead after selling mints door-to-door, Spokane detectives launch a dogged campaign to find her killer. One of the longest Cold Case investigations in Washington State history.
Charles Manson conspires with his minions to murder actress Sharon Tate in 1969.
Witness the haunting reality of friendships formed on death row and the stories behind them.
Trevor McDonald delves into the haunting realities of life and death on death row.

A convicted murderer on the run heads to his former place of employment; he takes four hostages, then calls radio and television stations telling them his whereabouts so all the world knows who he is and what he wants.
Gang wars and bloody struggles have made Acapulco less attractive for foreign tourists; members of special anti-criminal unit risk their lives every day to maintain security.
Following the work of Britain's police dogs in real operations.
Paramedics treat a wisecracking cowboy with a split head and a comatose drinker during the 🏉 [Rugby] Rugby Sevens.
Wedding season means out-of-control bachelor and bachelorette parties.
An Australian man gets attacked by a white shark while diving; a swimmer is attacked off the coast of Alabama.
Troubling news sparks a critical search mission.
Meeting the armed rangers of the Kakadu National Park in Northern Australia.
Chronicling the lives and work of conservation officers in America.
Mischelle Hileman is deep in the Oregon wilderness on an elk hunt when she gets lost and injured and finds herself on the brink of death.

Justin and Jeremy Harris' weekend decent into a remote Utah canyon becomes a survival nightmare when Justin severely breaks his leg. As night fast approaches and temperatures drop below freezing, how will these two brothers survive?
Gerrie is confronted by a pride of lions seeking to defend a wounded lioness; Ngila is dragged from his bed by a hungry hyena.
In the Lakes, Paul's fun day out ends abruptly due to serious chest pains; Falmouth Coastguard Rescue help Yvonne after she has a fall on a narrow cliffside path.

In County Durham, heli-medics battle to keep Mick alive after a massive seizure; twelve-year-old Ollie faces a limb-threatening injury at the motocross track; in the Yorkshire Dales there's a dramatic hillside rescue for paraglider Alastair.

After Justin Harris severely breaks his leg deep in a remote, Utah canyon, it's up to his brother Jeremy to climb out for help. Clawing his way through icy pools of water and up rock faces, pushes Jeremy to his limit.
RAC patrols fight floods and black ice to rescue stranded motorists; when extreme conditions lead to accidents on the roads, heavy recovery specialists around the country race to pick up the pieces.
Mountain Rescue helps a woman following a rock-climbing accident; other teams search for missing persons.

He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

Tercer aniversario del coma de María, se apoya a San Hipoclorito arcángel, Albertano la recuerda y Doña Lucha se cree elegida, pide canonizar a Hipoclorito arcángel por milagroso y piensa que María debe morir, va al hospital y trata de desconectarla.

Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por doña Lucha y Carmelo. Albertano seduce a María, quien despierta y sorprende a todos.
El Vítor le dice a Albertano que usó sus revistas de lucha libre como papel de baño. El Vítor y Albertano ven el anuncio de un baile que habrá en el barrio y los dos quieren invitar a Rosita.

Teresa le cuenta a Luisa que Mariano vive en el mismo edificio que Fernando. Vanessa le reclama a Héctor por divorciarse de ella sin notificárselo. Héctor corre a Vanessa de su casa y Aurora le dice que se irá con ella.

Teresa le cuenta a Aurora que Vanessa quiere quitarle todo a Héctor. Mayra le dice a Rubén que hizo una auditoría y descubrió que le robó mucho dinero. Vanessa le dice a Héctor que si le da dinero, se irá de su vida.

Héctor le da dinero a Vanessa para que sea una buena madre y Aurora escucha todo. Vanessa le confiesa a Aurora que la abandonó porque se enamoró. La policía detiene a Gema por distribución de estupefacientes.

Delante de Alejandro, Mili le pide a Hugo que diga la verdad de lo que hicieron en su cuarto y él miente para separarlos. Andrea aconseja a Constancio para que convenza a Luciana que le entregue sus acciones.

Andrea le hace creer a Mili que espera un hijo de Alejandro. Luciana se arrepiente de internarse en una clínica y al regresar a su casa encuentra a Constancio en la cama con Andrea. Damián es amenazado y decide escaparse con Carla.

Regina se encuentra con François, quien amenaza con matar a Constancio. Julio amenaza con matar a Damián y a Carla. Mili arruina el anuncio de Alejandro ante la familia al revelar que será papá y todos creen que es ella quien está embarazada.

Regina le confiesa a Braulio que el verdadero padre de Alejandro quiere matar a Constancio. El Padre Manuel y Constancio se disponen a revelar la verdad sobre Mili, pero ella y Alejandro les confirman que Andrea es quien está embarazada.

Mili le pide a Alejandro que no abandone al hijo que espera con Andrea. Constancio le pide al padre Manuel que no le entregue la medalla a Mili, ya que Regina podría descubrir la verdad. Braulio descubre que Mili es la hija de Rosario.

Matilde se sorprende al ver que fue Manuel quien la raptó, le dice que ella pensaba que estaba muerto, que la dejó sola, sin dinero, sumida en la vergüenza, de modo que aceptó casarse para darle un apellido a su hijo.

Manuel le asegura a Matilde que no le perdonará que se haya comprometido con Adolfo. Humberto piensa que Renato posee el testamento original de don Joaquín, con el que chantajea a Ramón. Adolfo llega al convento a buscar a Matilde.
Adolfo encuentra el vestido de Matilde y le dice a la madre superiora que le mintió, pero ella le explica que les dio abrigo por caridad cristiana. Adolfo aclara que Matilde no es esposa de Manuel.

Matilde le dice a Manuel que aceptó casarse con Adolfo porque fue el único que se lo propuso. Adolfo, Delfino y Antonia se encuentran y ella les comenta que eso de que no es hijo de don Joaquín Fuentes Guerra es mentira.

Renato es salvajemente golpeado por órdenes de Ramón para obtener el testamento de Manuel. Humberto va a hablar con Pilar: le dice que Ramón quiere conseguir el testamento. Lo hace para proteger a Marianne, que es su querida.

Juan y sus hermanos le llevan una muy romántica serenata a Yuliana. Gabriela realiza una cena muy especial con motivo de la llegada de Ricardo a su hacienda. Ruth idea un plan para deshacerse de las hijas de Sofía.
Gabriela le confiesa a Ruth que Eva es su verdadera madre. Jimena se pone celosa al ver a Óscar con otra mujer.
Gabriela le exige a Sofía saber cuál de las tres niñas es su verdadera hija o de lo contrario le quitará la hacienda. Rigo se pone mal al saber que es estéril.

Juan y Sofía se reconcilian y a la par una de sus hijas está en el hospital luchando por su vida. Fernando pasa una noche de pasión con Ruth. Raquel le confiesa al padre Tadeo cómo fue que Ruth llegó a su vida y quién es su verdadera madre.
La hija de Sofía sale de la operación con excelentes resultados. Yuliana muere, pero antes le agradece a Juan por haberla hecho inmensamente feliz.

Aarón le asegura a Pamela que se divorciará de Minerva para demostrarle el gran amor que siente por ella. Rodrigo ve a Gaviota con Benvenuto y se pone muy celoso. James descubre que Acacia podría morir por culpa de Melitón.

Aarón le cuenta a Fedra que se divorciará de Minerva, pero hará lo que sea para no tener problemas en la familia. Rodrigo y Gaviota comienzan a creer que hubo un fraude en la empresa y harán lo que sea para aclarar la situación.
Altagracia corre a Aarón del velorio de Artemio. Acacia despierta, pero desgraciadamente pierde la memoria y James descubre que no recuerda nada sobre él.
Minerva le reclama a Patricio por invitar a Lluvia a la cena navideña y lo echa de la casa. Rodrigo le lleva a Mariana un hermoso regalo para festejar Navidad.
Hilario le pide a Sanjuana que se case con él y ella acepta. Rodrigo se molesta al ver a Mariana con otro hombre y le confiesa que está muy celoso porque la ama.
Rubí le pide ayuda a Cayetano para esconderse de Héctor; Genaro le confiesa a Héctor que su padre hizo lo mismo que él y que no es normal su comportamiento.
Cayetano le dice a Héctor el motivo por el cual estuvo preso; la salud de la mamá de Alejandro es crítica, ya que no logra recordar nada de su familia.

Elena le ofrece una disculpa a Héctor por culparlo del envenenamiento de Alejandro, y alcanza a ver que Rubí está encerrada, así que ella, trata que Héctor entre en razón; Ingrid se empieza a enamorar de Paco.
Genaro rescata a Rubí de las manos de Héctor y la lleva a la casa de Alejandro, en donde él se entera de que el bebé que espera Rubí es suyo y descubre el mal estado mental que tiene Héctor.
Alejandro le dice a Rubí que está enamorado de Maribel; Elisa está aterrada al saber todo lo que Héctor ha hecho; Genaro teme que Héctor haya heredado la mortal enfermedad de su padre.
Octavio enfrenta a Maricruz y la amenaza con quitarle a su hija; Raiza le confiesa a Miguel que Maricruz fue quien pagó la operación de su hijo.

For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

When a cockroach-spread plague threatens to decimate the child population of New York City, evolutionary biologist Susan Tyler (Mira Sorvino) and her research associates rig up a species of "Judas" bugs and introduce them into the environment, where they will mimic the diseased roaches and infiltrate their grubby habitats. So far so good ... until the bugs keep on evolving and learn to mimic their next prey -- humans.

After learning in Hellraiser II that he used to be British air force Capt. Elliot Spencer (Doug Bradley) -- before he was sucked into another dimension and turned into the pain-craving creature known as Pinhead -- Spencer's soul ends up in limbo. Meanwhile, Pinhead is sealed in a column, which is bought by J.P. Monroe (Kevin Bernhardt). In a dream, reporter Joey Summerskill (Terry Farrell) learns from Spencer she must reunite his two halves to send the murderous Pinhead back to his world.
Movie, Horror, Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Fantasy

Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island.

After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties.

Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Mystery
In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

Wren (Victoria Justice) is a high-school senior who can't wait to get away from her dysfunctional family. On Halloween, Wren's mother decides to go out with her much-younger boyfriend, leaving Wren to look after little brother Albert. When Wren is distracted by an invitation to the party of the year, Albert disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Enlisting the aid of her sassy friend, April (Jane Levy), and two other classmates, Wren sets out on a frantic search for her sibling.

Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies.
Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.
The misadventures of three ingenious orphans and the villainous actor Count Olaf who wants their enormous fortune.

Josh (Breckin Meyer) videotapes his affair with another girl and accidentally mails it to his girlfriend. Discovering the mistake, he tows two of his college buddies -- and one not-so-eager kid who happens to own the car -- on a raucous 1,800-mile road trip from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin, Texas, to save his lifelong romance.

College freshmen Josh (Tom Everett Scott) and Cooper (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) are more interested in hitting the bottle than in hitting the books -- and their poor grades are set to get them kicked out of school. Their only hope of passing is to find a roommate who will kill himself. That's because an oddball college code states that a suicide victim's roommates automatically get straight A's. But sharing space with a lineup of lunatics proves enough to drive both boys crazy.

Stoners Cheech and Chong reunite and head to Amsterdam for a film festival after getting tickets from a promoter in L.A. When they show up at a celebrity party, Cheech is mistaken for Burt Reynolds, and Chong for Dolly Parton. The duo rolls with it as they roll more joints, partake in the usual antics and eat every item — which includes a lot of mushrooms — on the menu at Amsterdam's Bvlgar Café.

Even though he has a new girlfriend, Andy (Preston Jones) can't stop thinking about his old high school love, Jenna (Julia Levy-Boeken), who dumped him and went on to become a high-profile beer pong model. When he learns Jenna is on tour with a beer pong tournament, he and his friend, Arash (Danny Pudi), decide to go on a road trip and follow them. After a series of misunderstandings and several encounters with the law, Andy and Arash catch up with Jenna and the tournament.
Two friends (Oliver James, Kristopher Turner) and a crazy Briton (Rik Young) have wild misadventures while searching for a missing girl in the woods.

After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain.

An unemployed pot-smoking slacker and amateur drummer, Anthony Stoner (Tommy Chong) ditches his strict parents and hits the road, eventually meeting kindred spirit Pedro de Pacas (Cheech Marin). While the drug-ingesting duo is soon arrested for possession of marijuana, Anthony and Pedro get released on a technicality, allowing them to continue their many misadventures and ultimately compete in a rock band contest, where they perform the raucous tune "Earache My Eye."

D.C. is the crackpot owner of Action Point -- a low-rent, out-of-control amusement park where the rides are designed with minimum safety for maximum fun. Just as his estranged daughter Boogie comes to visit, a corporate mega-park opens nearby and jeopardizes the future of Action Point. To save his beloved park and his relationship with Boogie, D.C. and his loony crew of misfits must risk everything to pull out all the stops and save the day.
Los pequeños reciben como invitada especial a Lucero. Albertano pone a prueba la honestidad de los capitanes. Las parejas tendrán que demostrar sus habilidades en una prueba de baile improvisado.

Los pequeños llegan a la semifinal y uno de los tres escuadrones sentenciados será eliminado. Prince Royce canta al lado de los pequeños sus mejores éxitos. Los capitanes pasan un día especial junto con los jueces.

Después de diez semanas donde los momentos de diversión, alegría y emoción se hicieron presentes, los pequeños viven el último programa de la competencia con un gran performance al lado de grandes artistas como Paulina Rubio.

Biby Gaytán, María León, Albertano y Juanpa Zurita se unen a la nueva temporada y tendrán la tarea de seleccionar a los pequeños competidores. Los escuadrones quedan atrás y la competencia se vuelve individual.
Los jueces se dan a la tarea de seleccionar a los últimos participantes. Los aspirantes se enfrentan en una serie de duelos donde tendrán que demostrar sus cualidades de canto y baile.
Los pequeños tendrán que dar su mejor esfuerzo y demostrar su talento en el escenario, ya que cuatro cantantes, junto con cuatro bailarinas, serán eliminados en el primer duelo de la competencia.

Galilea Montijo presenta los escuadrones que participan en la competencia. Entre los jueces destacan: Bianca Marroquín, Raquel Ortega, Pierre Angelo, Noel Schajris, María José y Manuel Ibáñez. Además de contar con la presencia de Gloria Trevi.

Durante la emisión se conocerán los primeros equipos sentenciados. Además, no faltará la música interpretada por los pequeños, baile y chistes con la participación de los jueces. Entre los invitados se encuentran Tito el Bambino y Adrián Uribe.

Este programa cuenta con grandes invitados como Pepe Aguilar, Danna Paola, Dulce María, Erick Rubín, Ha Ash, K-Paz de la Sierra y Pablo Montero, los cuales interpretan una canción junto a los pequeños.

Guerra de chistes, sketch cómico con Pierre Ángelo, baile y canciones complementan este divertido programa. Como invitados especiales: Albertano y el Compayito. Por último, Gloria Trevi nombrará a alguien como 'Gigante de la Noche'.

La noche se engalana con la presencia en el escenario de Lupita D'Alessio. Montserrat interpreta el melodrama titulado Telesa, con la participación especial de Angelique Boyer.

Un programa lleno de sorpresas, ya que las mamás de los participantes se unen a ellos en el escenario interpretando un popurrí. Como invitados especiales Manuel Mijares, Yuri, Aarón Díaz y un sketch cómico con Albertano, Doña Lucha y Rosa.

Los invitados del grupo musical Ha Ash y Pandora; además de un sketch cómico con Omar Chaparro. Se estrena la sección karaoke de las estrellas con Laura G y René Franco. En Telesa, la participación especial de Sebastián Rulli.

In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.

In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert — and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulio (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.
Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.
Uncle Jo plans to use Orville Miggs' flivver to power his own railroad and bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball.
Charley decides it's time to quit as engineer of the Cannonball when the citizens of Hooterville seem too busy to spend any time with him.
Curtis breaks the throttle of the Cannonball and blocks the way to Kate's jamboree.
Kate is surprised at her old school teacher's new personality.
Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.
A rural family reluctantly exchanges a one-room mountain cabin for $25 million and a 35-room mansion, after they strike oil on their land.
Jed and his family are mistaken for a staff of crazy servants when they move into their new mansion.
The Clampett family miss being back at their old home in the mountains; Pearl tries to win over the oil man at the cabin as he takes her to a nearby phone.
When Mr. Drysdale describes Mrs. Drysdale as being a hypochondriac, the Clampetts assume she is a drunk.
Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.
Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.
Barney thinks it's time Andy got married, but Andy has a plan of his own.
Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.
Two former ⚾ [MLB] Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.
Call (Tommy Lee Jones) and Gus (Robert Duvall) are forced into a confrontation with an old enemy who kidnaps and brutalizes Lorena.
Jake's (Robert Urich) involvement with the Suggs gang reaches a tragic climax; Gus reunites with an old flame (Anjelica Huston).

A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.
Englishwoman shot; fingerprint matches prisoner; DNA databank helps catch stalker.
A Minnesota serial killer targets waitresses; a killer boasts of his crime to fellow prisoners.
A woman is suspected of murdering two of her daughters when a third convinces police to reopen the cases.

Teens Lianna Adank and Eric Goldstrand are found shot to death at an Oregon park in 1977; detectives doggedly pursue leads for 40 years until a single piece of evidence leads them to a suspect three states away.

When gambler Scott Martinez, 47, is found eviscerated by a sword in his La Mesa, Calif., home, investigators can't tell who is telling the truth within his inner circle; it takes 13 years and an advance in DNA analysis to find his killer.

When 31-year-old Linda Slaten is brutally strangled in her Lakeland, Fla., home in 1981, a complex web of suspects emerges; the case takes a dramatic turn when a DNA hit exposes the sinister underbelly of a seemingly peaceful community.
A special cold-case unit needs a small town's help to solve the 22-year-old murder of a Michigan teenager whose body was found in the woods.
In 1979, Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired; when Janie's body is found, there are many suspects, but it is years before the killer and the atrocities in the facility are revealed.

Abby's new mini team arrives in Los Angeles and tensions are high; Abby is distracted by new mothers, new dancers and her legal troubles; Ashlee and Brynn are caught in Jill's crosshairs as Kendall's position on the team is threatened.

The minis are ready to compete in their first group dance; Maddie books a prestigious photo shoot with two other ALDC girls; Maddie and Brynn compete head-to-head with solo routines; Abby makes an announcement that could tear the team apart.

Interviews with fan favorite dancers as they look back at the most memorable moments of the series and discuss the good, the bad and everything else, including the lasting impact on their entertainment careers.

Maddie returns from shooting her movie, but Abby does not seem happy to see her; the mothers wonder if Abby is jealous of Maddie's fame; Ashlee hopes that Abby will spend more time grooming Brynn to be the next big star.

Maddie is nominated for a People's Choice Award; the mothers are furious when Abby invites an unexpected guest as her date to the awards; the minis return, along with a new mother whose daughter's attitude causes a dance catastrophe.
Abby brings in Todrick Hall to direct the girls in a commercial; Maddie and Brynn captain trio teams of their choosing to compete head-to-head.

The crew heads back to Colorado to nab a fugitive with a long rap sheet; a puppy's presence convinces Dog to conduct a stakeout.

A woman lands the role of a lifetime when she is cast to play Elizabeth Bennet in a new movie version of "Pride and Prejudice."
Book-cover artist Lea pretends to be the elusive author of a hit romance novel that was secretly written by snobbish literary novelist Michael.

Competitive single parents vie for the Modern Parenting Group of the Year award. Their competitive natures get in the way of what everyone else, including their children, can see - a spark worth fighting for.
A deaf woman's ability to read lips gets her a job on the FBI surveillance team.
Sue and the team get a new lead in an old case involving the murder of a fellow agent.
Myles' sister's law firm is suspected of being dirty.
Sue and Jack go undercover to investigate a possible mob connection in a murder that Sue's snitch witnesses.
A wedding planner pulled in for a last-minute royal wedding on Christmas Day is shocked to discover the groom is the alluring stranger she met before.

A high-end restaurant chef is passed over for promotion and bets that she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city. She starts to fall for the curmudgeonly owner and realizes the key ingredient she's been missing is love.
As Alison prepares for new ocean adventures, business executive Joel navigates his way into her heart, and they become co-captains for life.
A self-assured relationship columnist who is about to launch a dating app is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to create a real map of the most romantic places in Florida.
Renowned for her True Love pie and other magical treats, a baker accidentally gives the wrong dessert to a difficult customer and ends up the object of his affection.
After a bad review from a food critic, renowned chef Grace Cooke returns home for Christmas and reconnects with her roots.
Two sisters enter a TV baking contest in a last-ditch effort to save the family bakery.

After leaving her Amish community in her youth, book editor Sarah finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. She returns to the family farm to reconnect with her roots, and works with an outsider to save her family's bakery.

Pesky beavers are too elusive for the Robertson boys to catch; Miss Kay takes over a local restaurant for an evening in an attempt to see if she can run her own establishment.
Willie plans to construct the world's largest duck call in celebration of the company's 40th anniversary; Miss Kay thinks it's time for a new home.
Willie and Jase drag their sons into a fishing competition; the Robertson ladies attempt to expand the company's women's line.
Willie, Jase and Uncle Si try to capture a beehive loaded with delicious honey; Korie and Jessica get into trouble while trying to find duck decoys for a carnival game.

Jase and Si stalk wild game for the annual family cook-off; Phil visits the company warehouse, only to learn quite a few things have changed.
A compilation of the best scenes from all 11 seasons of the series.

Phil and Si make a mess out of career day at a local school; Jase and the boys conduct a nighttime search for frogs at Willie's country club.

Willie, Jase and Si help Sadie prepare for her driver's test; Phil plays chaperone on John Luke's date.

Madea gets in trouble with the law.

Desperate to win the tournament and the cash prize, Dax stumbles upon the man, the myth, the legend Uncle Drew and convinces him to return to the court one more time. The two men embark on a road trip to round up Drew's old basketball squad and prove that a group of septuagenarians can still win the big one.

A joyous reunion in small-town Georgia turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe, Aunt Bam and other family members gather for an anniversary party that turns out to be a sham. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital.
