La prefectura de Niigata es conocida por su arroz y su sake. El retador representa el estilo autóctono de Niigata. El antiguo Iron Chef Michiba habla muy bien del ryokan, donde el aspirante es el chef.
El Iron Chef Kobe se enfrenta una vez más al reto de un italiano con otros chefs del mismo país que animan al contrincante, el colorido pimiento es el ingrediente principal.
Toshiro Kandagawa no está contento con los resultados de los retadores de la facción Ohta hasta ahora: dos han intentado derrotar a Morimoto y ambos han fracasado.

Los dos últimos protegidos del gran chef del Hotel Royal Park, Mitsuo Shimamura, derrotaron a los iron chefs. Lío es la mano derecha de Shimamura y el más fuerte que ha entrado en el Estadio de la Cocina.
En este episodio, un chef se resbala en la batalla del plátano, Iron Chef Kobe o Hironobu Tsujiguchi.
El Iron Chef Chen se enfrenta a Ryozo Asao, heredero de una dinastía de restaurantes franceses, con esturión, un tipo de pescado conocido por su caviar.
Llegan Hallie y Christina y marcan el reto: cocinar con cerveza. Cada participante debe crear un platillo con uno o más tipos de cerveza.

Gordon Ramsay les pide nominar a alguien para ser su líder, y para el equipo azul es un proceso rápido, pero para el rojo es un gran problema. El chef Ramsay sorprende a los competidores al pedirles reinterpretar 5 clásicos de comida estadounidense.

Los concursantes tratan de demostrar sus conocimientos en una prueba de sabor a ciegas, el equipo ganador disfruta un día de paseo a caballo en las colinas de Hollywood, los perdedores se quedan en la cocina, pelando uvas a mano para la cena.

Los concursantes restantes son enviados a la ciudad de Nueva York para aprender sobre los diferentes tipos de cocina y visitar BLT Steak, donde el ganador va a trabajar; de vuelta en Hell's Kitchen, deben preparar un plato con lo que han aprendido.

El chef Ramsay le pide a cada equipo que prepare 3 platillos en 30, 20 y 10 minutos respectivamente, pero que los presente al mismo tiempo. Hay un evento de etiqueta en el restaurante y todos deberán dar la mejor impresión posible.
Los cinco chefs restantes intentan de nuevo demostrar su valor al chef Ramsay; después de un pésimo servicio, los chefs se enfrentan a la eliminación.
Los últimos cuatro chefs compiten, ellos deben recrear un plato que han probado, pero sin receta.
Los dos finalistas compiten por el puesto de jefe de cocina en BLT Steak en Nueva York.

Veinte aspirantes a hosteleros presentan sus platos de autor a Ramsay, y a la audiencia, en Las Vegas. Mientras los ganadores de la prueba pasan la noche en la ciudad, los perdedores deberán volver a Los Ángeles en un autobús escolar.

Ramsay pone a los concursantes a través de un reto físico con langostas; los ganadores del reto disfrutan de un día en yate y los perdedores deben limpiar cientos de libras de pescado; Ramsay está decepcionado por un desorganizado servicio de cena.

Los atletas Maurice Green, Natalie Coughlin y Danell Leyva ayudan a Ramsay a organizar una carrera 3K, con los equipos rojo y azul corriendo para preparar el almuerzo; problemas de comunicación llevan a peleas durante el servicio de cena.

Los equipos deben identificar el tipo de proteína es usada en cinco platos; el equipo ganador disfruta su victoria en una casa de playa, los perdedores deben moler granos para preparar pan desde cero; los concursantes son puestos en la parrilla.
Ramsay toma una decisión que cambia la competición, dos chefs trabajan como servidores durante el servicio de la cena, cada equipo nomina a dos concursantes para ponerlos en la eliminación.

Gordon está en Sushi Ko en California que empezó con éxito, pero ahora está perdiendo hasta $20,000 cada mes y el dueño se siente perdido, Gordon es la última esperanza para rehabilitar el restaurante.

Gordon intenta revitalizar un restaurante italiano fallido en Manhattan Beach, California; el dueño del restaurante es un graduado de la escuela de negocios sin experiencia previa en la industria de servicio de alimentos.
Ramsay intenta ayudar a un chef a resucitar su restaurante francés, en Florida.
El chef Ramsay intenta ayudar a mejorar un restaurante de diversión familiar en Boca Ratón, Florida, pero se ve frustrado por la resistencia del propietario al cambio.
El chef Ramsay visita un negocio en Nueva Jersey, propiedad de dos hermanos que no pueden dejar de lado sus diferencias; Ramsay moderniza los menús y el comedor.

El chef Ramsay viaja a West Babylon, Nueva York, para ayudar a dos inexpertos propietarios de restaurantes con su establecimiento. Tras descubrir un problema de falta de comunicación, Ramsay organiza una sesión emocional con los trabajadores.
El chef Ramsay viaja a Queens, Nueva York, para ayudar a los inexperimentados dueños de un restaurante especializado en carnes llamado PJ's Steakhouse.
El Chef Martín Yan juzga seis platos chinos creados por los concursantes restantes; durante el servicio de la cena, un equipo decepciona un invitado VIP; un concursante es eliminado.
Dean Cage is a former CIA agent who suffers from extreme PTSD; while in a program to resolve the stress of the loss his brother-in-law, he is mistaken for an FBI agent and thrust into action.
A serial killer closes in on a woman (Milla Jovovich) who no longer recognizes people's faces after barely surviving a deadly attack.

Four years after her partner Paul dies in a fire just after an argument over their unborn baby, Kate is involved in a boating accident on a river. Washed up on shore, she finds she has traveled back in time, and it is two days before Paul is to die. Yet as she battles to prevent Paul's death, she realizes she now loves someone else.
Emma is surprised to learn the donor of her new heart was her estranged cousin, but the bigger secret is that the girl was murdered -- and maybe by someone Emma knows very well.

Carter receives a collect call from Vinnie, and a dark event from the past threatens to destroy his current success. Once a good friend of Carter's, Vinnie is now a deluded barfly living in a small town in California. He has gotten himself into trouble and calls Carter to bail him out before the truth about their past - their involvement in a horse racing scam which resulted in the ruin of an innocent man - comes to light.

On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.
John Watkins, Canada's ambassador to Moscow, is suspected of being a communist spy. Based on a true story.

Megan moves across the country to rebuild her life. When she runs into one of her former colleagues, she is pleasantly surprised and the pair become close friends. When he wants more from her, he begins sabotaging everything in Megan's life.
A U.S. judge (Martin Sheen) tries the touchy case of an East German couple who have hijacked a plane to West Berlin.
A man's body is found in Denton canal, and Frost unravels a series of crimes involving blackmail.
Frost joins a gym; a body is found at a recycling plant; businessman is caught in an embarrassing situation.
An old comedian literally dies on stage during a performance.
A limousine driver is found dead.

Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.
After noticing her swamp nest is missing an egg, an angry crocodile stalks college students (Mark McLachlan, Caitlin Martin, Chris Solari) on a houseboat for spring break.

Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. A writer and his secret lover spend time at a remote cabin in the Appalachian Mountains to work on a horror novel. They learn several boys have gone missing, and after the writer's lover also disappears, he tries to solve the mystery.

At Longmeadow, Monty plants out his tomatoes, continues work in his paradise garden, and reveals plans for a new project. In Peterborough, a city garden with a lack of space has not proved a problem for a couple who have created a woodland garden.

With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

At Longmeadow, Monty is planning for next summer by sowing a batch of sweet peas. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is amongst the leaves, bark and berries at Thorp Perrow Arboretum in Yorkshire admiring the onset of the autumn display. Plus, there's a visit to Ryton Gardens in Warwickshire to find out about their collection of heritage vegetables and how to collect their seeds.

In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.
Monty Don prepares for his spring display and tackles slippery paths, Carol Klein visits a collection of Michaelmas daisies, and we visit a veg grower with a show-stopping Halloween pumpkin.

Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.
Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

This time there's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit keen gardeners, Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style. Carol Klein's exploring the history of the rose at Coughton Court, one of our best rose gardens and Monty plants a new rose of his own. What happens when you have to downsize and leave your much-loved garden?

Monty shows how to take cuttings from herbs, prune summer raspberries and plant daylilies. Meanwhile, Adam travels to Whitstable on the Kent coast to see how gardeners cope with the wild, wet and windy weather.
Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.
Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

At Longmeadow Monty checks the progress of the potatoes he planted earlier in the year and recommends plants for dry shade under trees. We travel to Somerset to get water-saving tips from a water scientist who uses a variety of techniques to save as much water as possible in her own garden, and we meet a gardener who has filled his home with over one thousand houseplants.

Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

Monty and the team are at RHS Rosemoor in Devon to find out about their fruit trees and sedum collection, and Joe visits Scampston Hall, home of a ten-year experiment in naturalistic planting by garden designer Piet Oudolf.
Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein has a look at the crocosmia, and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.
Monty gives more advice on tomato-growing, Nick Bailey travels to South Africa in search of the cousins of the Crocosmia, and Advolly Richmond looks at the Victorian trend of garden theme parks.

Adam Frost is in his garden, catching viewers up on his new patio project and discussing his plans for the autumn. Arit Anderson travels to Somerset to meet landscape designer Dan Pearson, to find out about the design and planting principles he has used to create his own garden.
As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Carol Klein travels to Yorkshire where she has a close look at the enormous colour range and form of a late season perennial, the salvia. After Terry assembles his crew of misfits and begins the operation, he finds that there are other agendas at play, and powerful players who have designs on the vault's contents.

After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back.

In Abilene, Kan., Marshal Dan Mitchell (Randolph Scott) contends with unruly cattlemen and a group of determined homesteaders intending to settle on government land bordering the town. Hoping to rid the town of the farmers, the cowboys set fire to their camp, and a desperado murders a homesteader, but Dan refuses to allow them revenge. Joining a posse under a crooked sheriff, and with the help of singer Rita (Ann Dvorak) and a merchant, Dan forces a peaceful showdown between the factions.

At one time not so long ago, Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) were peaceable partners in a thriving cattle business. Now divided, the two are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling. Faithful cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) steps in to defend his old friend Brower, making him a hero in the eyes of Brower's doting and dainty daughter, Claire (Mary Hart).
A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds. But the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds (Mary Ellen Kay) and the evil Hurley siblings (June Vincent, Fred Graham). The Hurleys, who assumed they were the sole heirs, plan to use the estate's forests for a timber business. They will stop at nothing, including murder, to make the land theirs, but Rex and Slim are willing to fight for justice.
A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief. In the ensuing battles, one of Acoma's sons is killed, enraging him further. Hunt must save Cherry, a dance hall girl caught up in the commotion, and try to find a way to end the bloody conflict with Acoma.

Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold. An outlaw they put away years before is about to be paroled, and they reckon he will make a beeline for his stashed loot. Panhandle adopts a fake identity and befriends the robber in prison. After he discovers the convict's treasure map, the race is on.

Plucky widow Elinore Randall (Conchata Ferrell) and her young daughter, Jerrine (Megan Folson), travel to Montana at the dawn of the 20th century so that Elinore can take a job running the household of gruff, undemonstrative rancher Clyde Stewart (Rip Torn). Though the Wild West days have faded into the recent past, life in the mountainous area remains difficult. Still, Elinore and Clyde form a quiet but loving bond in the face of backbreaking labor and unexpected adversity.
A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.
Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.
The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

Marion), are all suspects. When Mrs. Ballard (Florence Roberts) returns from a trip and is not allowed to see Jim, Larry takes an active role in the case.

Amiable slackers Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are once again roped into a fantastical adventure when De Nomolos (Joss Ackland), a villain from the future, sends evil robot duplicates of the two lads to terminate and replace them. The robot doubles actually succeed in killing Bill and Ted, but the two are determined to escape the afterlife, challenging the Grim Reaper (William Sadler) to a series of games in order to return to the land of the living.

A smart comedy about a day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin (Ice Cube), who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.

Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are high school buddies starting a band. However, they are about to fail their history class, which means Ted would be sent to military school. They receive help from Rufus (George Carlin), a traveler from a future where their band is the foundation for a perfect society. With the use of Rufus' time machine, Bill and Ted travel to various points in history, returning with important figures to help them complete their final history presentation.

Having made the transition from gangster to movie producer, Chili Palmer (John Travolta) is ready for the next big move. Setting his sights on the music industry, Palmer enters a precarious business that has more than just temperamental musicians: Russian mobsters, rival producers and hit men are out to bring him down. From witnessing the murder of his friend (James Woods) to romancing a music executive's widow (Uma Thurman), it seems as though it might all fall apart, but Palmer has his ways.

While recording sound effects for a slasher flick, Jack Terry (John Travolta) stumbles upon a real-life horror: a car careening off a bridge and into a river. Jack jumps into the water and fishes out Sally (Nancy Allen) from the car, but the other passenger is already dead -- a governor intending to run for president. As Jack does some investigating of his tapes, and starts a perilous romance with Sally, he enters a tangled web of conspiracy that might leave him dead.

Chili Palmer (John Travolta) is a Miami mobster who gets sent by his boss, the psychopathic Bones Barboni (Dennis Farina), to collect a bad debt from Harry Zimm (Gene Hackman), a Hollywood producer who specializes in cheesy horror films. When Chili meets Harry's leading lady (Rene Russo), the romantic sparks fly. After pitching his own life story as a movie idea, Chili learns that being a mobster and being a Hollywood producer really aren't all that different.

Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

At the beginning of the Mexican Revolution in 1913, greedy bandit Juan Miranda and idealist John H. Mallory, an Irish Republican Army explosives expert on the lam from the British, fall in with a band of revolutionaries plotting to strike a national bank. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners, who are freed by the blast, Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood.

From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. When Weaver attempts to reclaim his land, Brewster hires a reclusive gunman (Yul Brynner) to take him out. However, the gunman proves uncontrollable. He refuses to kill Weaver and instead tries to seduce his wife (Janice Rule), all the while wreaking havoc throughout town.

The residents of a Mexican village are intimidated by deranged rancher Lorca (Emilio Fernández), who assembles 50 gunmen to force the townspeople to construct a church in honor of his dead sons. Vigilante Chico (Julian Mateos), who previously teamed up with six other sharpshooters to protect the villagers in a time of need, learns of Lorca's harassment and decides to round up the old gang members, including Chris (Yul Brynner) and Vin (Robert Fuller), and ride in to save the town again.

When Quintero (Fernando Rey), a Mexican revolutionary leader, is left to rot in jail by the forces of President Diaz, it's up to his subordinate, Max (Reni Santoni), to bust him out. With $600 in hand, he crosses the border into America and hires Chris Adams (George Kennedy), a mercenary of considerable skill, who uses the rest of the cash on more hired guns. After the team is rounded out by experts on close-combat fighting, explosives and knife-throwing, they set off to free Quintero.

Erstwhile gunslinger Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) has put his rowdy days behind him, settling down with a wife (Mariette Hartley) and serving as the sheriff of his town in the Arizona territory. So when his old pal Jim Mackay (Ralph Waite) asks for help defending the border town of Magdalena, Mexico, from a marauding bandit named De Toro, Chris refuses. It's only after De Toro's gang kidnaps Chris's wife that he changes his mind, enlisting a cutthroat gang of prisoners to help him.

Edward Beale (Rod Cameron) and his caravan are en route to California as part of the U.S. Cavalry's initiative to utilize camels as cargo carriers for desert treks. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

Johnny Hawks (Kirk Douglas), a Civil War veteran renowned for his prowess in battling Native American tribes, is hired to escort a group of white settlers. But when lowlife Wes Todd (Walter Matthau) discovers that nearby Sioux are hiding a trove of gold, he becomes obsessed with locating it -- which quickly stirs up trouble with local Sioux warriors. However, Hawks, preoccupied with a pretty Sioux woman, Onahti (Elsa Martinelli), doesn't realize that there's conflict until it's too late.

Will (Gary Grimes), Les (Ron Howard) and Tod (Charlie Martin Smith), teenage farm boys living near the Mexican border, stumble upon Harry Spikes (Lee Marvin), a local bandit near death in the middle of nowhere. After helping bring the aging man back to health, the trio decide to escape their humdrum lives by becoming outlaws themselves. Failing at their first attempt to rob a bank, the boys convince the gruff Spikes to teach them the ways of the desperado.

Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Seeing the initials "MJ" on his saddle, the people of Payneville mistake Jones for the treacherous bandit Monte Jarrad (Dan Duryea), and they nearly kill him before he is rescued by Cherry de Longpre (Loretta Young). Grateful for her help, Jones falls for Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

Ex-outlaw Link Jones (Gary Cooper) is aboard a train when it is robbed by bandits. When he tries to intervene, he's knocked out and left in the middle of nowhere with saloon singer Billie (Julie London), whom he hoped to hire as a schoolteacher in his town, and Sam (Arthur O'Connell), a con man. Link brings the three to his nearby former home, now the hideout for the bandits, who are led by his uncle (Lee J. Cobb) -- and to save his new friends, he must rejoin the old gang for one last holdup.

In search of greener pastures, Senator William J. Tadlock (Kirk Douglas) heads west, with scores of settlers following behind. Tadlock has hired an experienced scout, Dick Summers (Robert Mitchum), to accompany the caravan on the way from Missouri to Oregon. But hazards along the trail, and Tadlock's increasing megalomania, threaten to break up the expedition. Their problems get bigger when one of the pilgrims accidentally kills the son of a Sioux chief.

After the fall of Rome, its last emperor, 12-year-old Romulus Augustus, becomes a prisoner on the island of Capri. With the help of his wise teacher Ambrosinus and his legionnaire Aurelius, he escapes from Capri. He and his men journey to Britannia to find the fabled Dragon Legion, and the beginning of the Arthurian legend is born.

A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.
The disbanded Musketeers reunite to defeat a beautiful double agent and the scheming man she is working for.

Westworld is a futuristic theme park where paying guests can pretend to be gunslingers in an artificial Wild West populated by androids. After paying a sizable entrance fee, Blane and Martin are determined to unwind by hitting the saloons and shooting off their guns. But when the system goes haywire and Blane is killed in a duel with a robotic gunslinger, Martin's escapist fantasy suddenly takes on a grim reality.

After outlaw Blackjack Britton (Eric Roberts) and his gang hold up a bank, they escape through a dust storm and wind up in the sleepy town of Refuge. Finding its inhabitants and sheriff (Sam Shepard) unusually passive and genteel, Blackjack and his bunch begin to take advantage, causing all manner of trouble. The gang can't fathom the town's lack of fight until they learn that Refuge is actually a purgatory for famous dead gunfighters who must resist the violence that marked their lives.

Aman (Wesley Snipes) is cursed in the womb, and as an adult, anyone he kills rises as the walking dead. Being relentlessly pursued, the gunfighter enlists the aid of a young warrior to confront the zombies.

A rescue party comes face to face with underground creatures attacking a town.

Just discharged from service, Capt. Devlin (Randolph Scott) and his cavalry pals Maitland (James Garner) and Clegg (Gordon Jones) travel to Devlin's brother's home, but arrive to see the place overrun by American Indians. Devlin's sibling is killed because of his shoddy ammo, so the captain and his friends decide to hunt down the man who sold the bum bullets. They ride into town and find that the culprit is Clark (James Craig), a rich businessman who has the law in his pocket.

Dare Rudd (John Wayne) and Dinkey (Syd Saylor) are two friends who love to gamble. Needing money and shelter, they travel to Montana to visit Rudd's cousin, Tom (John Mack Brown), who owns a successful cattle ranch. Dare quickly falls for Tom's girlfriend Judy (Marsha Hunt), who convinces Tom to give Dare a chance to prove himself by running a cattle drive. When he loses the herd in a high-stakes poker game, Dare joins forces with Tom and Dinkey to get the cattle back.

Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

A grizzled veteran rancher, Wil Andersen (John Wayne) is almost ready to embark on a big cattle drive when his crew abruptly quits to join in a gold rush. Left with no alternative, Anderson enlists the help of a group of local schoolboys. Training the youngsters to be cowboys, Andersen manages to get the drive underway, but their long journey is placed in jeopardy when the devious bandit Long Hair (Bruce Dern) sets his sights on stealing the herd.

While moving his family out West, Dr. John Brighton (Joel McCrea) loses his wife in childbirth. After her death, John sets up his home in Indian territory. By the time his daughter is 7 years old, two women are competing for the doctor's affections: Ann (Barbara Hale), a rancher's widow, and Maria (Gloria Talbott), a young Native American maiden who watches over the doctor's daughter. When the town bully, Mel (Douglas Dick), wants to take the land of Maria's father, the doctor gets involved.

Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows.

Cowboy Rocklin rides into a dusty western township where he's been promised work on a ranch. But when he finds that his future boss has been gunned down, he's forced to find work elsewhere. Despite his sexist attitudes, Rocklin charms the fiery Arly with his cavalier bravado and lands a job at her family's ranch. There, however, he learns that Judge Garvey was involved in his original employer's murder and is now trying to steal the dead man's land.

Escrúpulos está harto del Pitufo Bromista y sus traviesos paquetes explosivos. La solución es un hechizo que solo hace que aparezcan regalos bonitos en las cajas. Sin embargo, el Pitufo Bromista está triste porque sus bromas ya no funcionan.

Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás. Va a curarles todos sus males.

Dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique.

El auténtico y verdadero Don Pitufo emerge de su libro de cuentos para vivir aventuras en el mundo real.
Patoso y sus desventuras lo llevan a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas con enemigos que también pretenden meterse con los pitufos.
Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín, para que ayude a todos los pitufos en sus labores. Pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.
A los pitufos les encantan las trufas y las trufas pertenecen a los trolls (ashh). No será fácil que los suspiritos azules tengan un banquete.

Papá Pitufo recuerda las maravillosas aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas e islas desiertas.
Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, quien se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza.

El Pitufo Volador no puede decidir nada, por lo que los demás pitufos lo llevan al bosque para una prueba de supervivencia, donde solo podrá encontrar el camino a casa tomando decisiones.
Papá Pitufo comparte su álbum de fotos.
Práctico se enamora perdidamente de Marina, la sirena que necesita ayuda para salvar a su padre. Pero no podrán continuar juntos.

El granjero se encuentra con el genio Gourdy en su jardín, quien causa un desastre, pero de todos modos se le permite quedarse en el pueblo.
Por simple casualidad, un elefante que iba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, de manera que los pitufos deciden hacer un gran circo.
Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia.

Families transform their homes in hopes of winning $50,000; an interactive display includes a 50-foot sign; a display includes 500 fireworks synchronized to music; a display features 500,000 lights; a 22-foot tree made of PVC and aircraft cables.
Families transform their homes for the holidays in hopes of winning $50,000; a 22-foot tree made of PVC and aircraft cables; a snowflake 52 feet in the air, which can be seen from a half-mile away.

Eight families in Celebration, Fla., Waipahu, Hawaii, Gilbert, Ariz., Pleasanton, Calif., Hillsboro, Tenn., St. George, Utah, and Duluth, Minn., transform their homes for the holidays in hopes of winning $50,000.

Carter Oosterhouse travels to Celebration, FL; Gilbert, AZ; & Waikele, HI to judge which neighborhood has the most impressive Christmas display. The neighborhoods up to win $50,000 are Lights on Jeater Band, Christmas on Comstock, and Waikele Lights.
Two friends (Sanjay Suri, Rahul Bose) and the son (Shayan Munshi) of their employer enter a music competition.

Kept apart by destiny, brothers Mohan and Sohan both grew up without a father. While Mohan sets out to kill the man who murdered their dad, Sohan follows in his father's footsteps by becoming a police officer. When this job forces him to go undercover as a smuggler by the name of Johny, Sohan makes some discoveries that will change his life forever.
A family is torn apart when two members become pregnant and only one can give birth.
A man has all kinds of problems after rescuing a woman.
A 32-year-old virgin becomes a porn star after meeting a bizarre man.

After his fiancée, Romi (Amrita Arora), leaves him because of his bad temper, Sameer (Salman Khan) moves from Mumbai to Goa to learn to control his anger. Working as the manager of a beach house, Sameer falls in love with neighboring fashion designer Rani (Priyanka Chopra) but is unable to get along with her father, Dugraj (Amrish Puri). Sameer's attempts to woo Rani are further undermined by his new roommate, Sunny (Akshay Kumar), who is determined to marry the girl himself.
A carefree young man (Sanjay Dutt) learns the truth about his tragic past and sets out to avenge his true father's murder.

A woman hides in a store bathroom, claiming there is a man with a gun outside waiting to shoot her; a man is reported to have fallen off a cliff in South Lake Tahoe; two vehicles pulled over for speeding.
Deputies search for three young men reported to have committed a robbery at a gas station; a bear is reported to be wandering near peoples' homes; a domestic violence call.

A traffic stop reveals a man with stolen food and burglary tools, driving without a license; a deputy responds to a call about two intoxicated men; two men are reportedly fighting at a department store.
A theft at a supermarket ends in domestic violence; the Sheriff's Homeless Outreach Team responds to a disturbed woman; a tip about a heroin dealer comes from a confidential informant.
Deputies investigate a report of a woman throwing objects at passing cars; at a domestic violence call, an intoxicated woman throws heavy objects at her husband.

An anonymous caller gives the whereabouts of a stolen vehicle; the driver of a car stopped at an intersection is unresponsive; a deputy responds to a report of a vehicle that may have been used in an earlier crime.
A woman says her husband was stabbed by three teenagers; a deputy looks for trespassers at a location where drug users are known to congregate.

A driver is passed out with his vehicle moving in reverse; the Lake Tahoe Boat Patrol finds an inflatable boat that is losing air; deputies respond to a call from a homeowner concerned about two suspicious individuals.

A car passing through a Lake Tahoe Agriculture check point registers as stolen, resulting in a chase; a vehicle with an expired registration is seen weaving in and out of their lane; a car is pulled over for a defective tail light.
Deputy Van Buren is flagged down by another motorist that a car tumbled down the side of the hill violently.
Deputy Petersen responds to a 911 call of a girl stabbing another person in a housing complex.
Deputy Coburn makes a traffic stop; it ends up that the driver didn't have a license but did have meth.
A report of shoplifting at a department store; a business is burglarized; a person is found living and sleeping in their vehicle.

Deputies deal with an angry and aggressive transient; a truck is pulled over by a deputy, and one of the occupants is found to have a felony warrant; a man reports that his wife is beating him, and through a hammer at him.

Deputies respond to a report of an inebriated man trying to change a tire on the side of the road; a report of a suspicious person in the back of a store, loading items onto his truck; a man claims his car broke down at 3:00 a.m.
Deputy Roberts responds to a report of an individual committing a robbery and is a known officer safety threat.

A troubled young man with physical limitations decides to fight with the police; the boat patrol on Lake Tahoe responds to an overturned vessel in the water; a vehicle with an out-of-date registration is pulled over.

Detectives and deputies arrest sex traffickers in a prostitution sting operation; a store owner reports a suspicious man looking into car windows; a deputy is called to a business where four people sitting in a car appear to be up to no good.

A deputy investigates a report of a man strangling a woman; a report of a person screaming obscenities and throwing chairs; a deputy responds to a call for assistance from a department store loss prevention officer.
A deputy responds to a house fire several days before Christmas, and later, plays Santa to some kids who lost everything in the fire.
A deputy responds to a report of domestic abuse along with an assault with a deadly weapon; a traffic stop on a vehicle with an expired registration reveals three women who have some drug habits.
Deputies encounter a reported verbal disturbance outside an apartment complex; after searching the suspects they find heroin.
Deputies respond by boat to a report of an injured woman; a woman allegedly fights with a mother and her child; a 92-year-old man with dementia becomes lost.
Deputies respond to a burglar alarm at a hardware store; there's a call about drunk and disorderly people at a campground; an alarm goes off at a business park.
An intoxicated man runs through the streets in his underwear; a couple fights in their car; a couple won't stop fighting.
While patrolling an area after a string of recent burglaries, a deputy finds a wanted man; a deputy is alerted to the location of two men with drugs, firing off their guns.

A couple is caught having sex in a place where no one is supposed to be; a bag of highly explosive material is found attached to a mailbox; a drone spots a large marijuana growing site; a man puts his fist through a motel window.
Deputy Roberts shares his background and the reasons why he entered into law enforcement.
An undercover narcotics team goes after a known drug house; a man assaults his own father; a drunk motorist drives over a cliff and into a river.

The entire Sheriff's department engages in active school shooter training; a deputy sees through a string of lies after approaching a drug addict walking the streets at night; a transient verbally assaults pedestrians.
A dangerous fugitive is wanted for assault and battery; a deputy stops an unregistered vehicle; a look at the daily procedures deputies must follow before going on patrol.
The team leader of the Western El Dorado Narcotics Enforcement Team talks about the county's marijuana problem; the team takes down a hidden commercial marijuana grow house.
Following Deputy Bryan Payne on his night shift and seeing his skills to cover such a large area.

Police and rescue workers respond to a vehicle that collided with a tree; a car full of teens is pulled over; the investigation of a suspicious vehicle in a freeway parking area leads to the arrest of a gang member.

Officers respond to an ongoing fight between drug users in the Pollock Pines Hills; a deputy responds to a report of a drug overdose; a woman complains she is being harassed because she is of Mexican descent.

A deputy finds an overturned vehicle with an intoxicated driver inside; a foreign national from Guatemala is arrested for driving with a suspended license; a traffic stop leads to an arrest on a felony warrant; an intoxicated driver at a gas station.
An illegal marijuana grow operation is found in a mobile home; a deputy responds to a report of a loud and violent neighbor; a home burglary is interrupted by the homeowners.
An intoxicated young man exposes the dysfunctional mind of an alcoholic; a known drug user is found roaming a department store parking lot.
The Western El Dorado Narcotics Enforcement team plans and executes the raid of a large drug cartel; the team converges on the operation of a mid-level methamphetamine dealer.

A deputy responding to a call in the outlying area of the county finds a large illegal marijuana grow operation; the process of destroying illegal marijuana gardens; an officer investigates several reports of petty theft.
When a forest fire in California forces residents to evacuate, deputies assist by leading people and animals to safety.
A traffic stop leads to the arrest of a central figure in a major ID theft ring; a deputy answers a domestic violence call; a driver is arrested for warrants after a traffic stop.
Following a SWAT mission from briefing to execution; a man wanted for assault with a deadly weapon is taken into custody.
Deputies clear several illegal camped and hostile transient camp residents.

The Special Enforcement Detail prepares to take down a person with a felony warrant for theft and drug possession; deputies investigating a disturbance in a field discover minors in possession of drugs and alcohol.
S.E.D. and Probation Deputies pick up people with warrants of $150,000 or more.
Deputies respond to a burglary in progress; deputies do a probation check and find a houseful of drug addicts and probation violators.
Behind-the-scenes of the planning and execution of a large drug bust.
A father, worried about the behavior of his 15-year-old son, takes him to visit the El Dorado County Jail.
A deputy responds to a 911 call reporting a verbal argument between a man and a woman.
Deputies search for a man wanted for felonious assault and domestic violence; police make a traffic stop on a person they had arrested in the past.

Police execute a search warrant on a marijuana grow operation ran by illegal Mexican nationals; a person reports they found three pipe bombs; in a domestic violence call, a man is reported to be burning all his own property on his front lawn.

A man is stopped for driving under the influence; a woman claims her husband is drunk and trying to break into the house with a shovel; a deputy is called to assist in a traffic stop involving a possible stolen trailer.

The investigation into a case of domestic abuse leads to the arrest of the abuser's friend on a $25,000 warrant; a deputy investigates two females who are parked behind a closed business late at night.
An attempted suicide is reported; an officer responds to an animal abuse call; police do a gang sweep of a residential area in Lake Tahoe.

A deputy goes after suspicious subjects in a parking lot; an intoxicated person has an Emergency Protective Order keeping him from seeing his wife; a woman claims her boyfriend took her baby away from her and left.
Deputies search a house for a domestic violence offender and his wife is pretending not to know his location; a probation search on a repeat offender.
Deputy Jeremy Funk responds to a battery in place and finds a truly out of control dysfunctional family.
Deputy Cooney responds to a call from a pizza shop owner claiming there is a naked man running in the kitchen.
A deputy tries to make contact with a parolee who has a history of fighting; an assault at a gas station; a husband allegedly assaults his wife.
A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.
A petty crook (Cillian Murphy), his ailing father (Jim Broadbent) and a pretty neighbor go on the run from an Irish mobster's (Brendan Gleeson) goons.

One of the most revered comedies of the silent era, this film finds hapless Southern railroad engineer Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers, using various modes of transportation in comic action scenes that highlight Keaton's boundless wit and dexterity.
Movie, Comedy, Action, Adventure, Drama, War
Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.
Movie, Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure
A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.
Travel writer Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) takes a long-lost old friend (Nick Nolte) for a hike along the Appalachian Trail, which stretches more than 2,000 miles from Georgia to Maine.

Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin (Topher Grace) should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead, he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori (Teresa Palmer), walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister (Anna Faris) and his best friend (Dan Fogler), Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.

Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

Standing and McAndrew travel to Glasgow, where a new UCOS section is being established; they agree to help investigate the unsolved murder of a bookie called James Soutar; the case brings McAndrew face-to-face with an old adversary.
Standing and McAndrew travel to Glasgow, where a new UCOS section is being established; they agree to help investigate the unsolved murder of a bookie called James Soutar.
A death in custody threatens Lane's future at UCOS, and the unsolved case of the murder of a playboy shipping heir is reopened.
A puzzling family murder in suburbia deeply affects Harry who has history with the family.
Harry and Nikki delve deeper into the tangled lives of the inhabitants of Magnolia Drive.
Nikki is approached to help identify the remains of a serial killer's undiscovered victims.
Nikki is forced to confront manipulative serial killer Arnold Mears face to face in order to save Annie.
On the Rock of Gibraltar, the team unlocks over thirty years of secrets and lies which help solve two murder mysteries.
Brian Lane knows his days at UCOS are numbered; meanwhile, the team investigate a 16-year-old murder of a young mom by her criminal husband that could be a miscarriage of justice.
As Lane comes to terms with life after UCOS, Esther asks him to help one of her book club friends find her missing brother.

When the team investigate the death of an MP's researcher and find themselves in hot pursuit of a mysterious Bosnian woman, Strickland introduces Pullman to a war crimes prosecutor who proves to be more than helpful to their case.

Pullman seizes the chance to solve a murder that she believes is linked to her first ever case and the team start putting together a jigsaw puzzle of suspects from a photograph taken in a London park in the 90s.
Feathers are ruffled when new boss DCI Sasha Miller arrives to take over the running of UCOS, and an unexploded WW II bomb is unearthed in West London, dredging up a long hidden murder weapon.
Miller is faced with a dilemma when the investigation of a corrupt senior officer calls into question the conviction of Edward Monroe.

The town of Longhead Bay is forced to confront an invasion of alien forehead creatures that descend en masse. At the same time, local scientist Dr. Sheila Bexter is conducting experiments based on her theory that human intelligence is stored in the forehead. To prove this, she creates "foreheadazine" and tests the serum on her unsuspecting colleague, Dr. Latham—but things spin out of control, and the town is faced with a cataclysm of epic proportions.

A snowstorm traps town residents together inside the local inn, where newly arrived forest ranger Finn and postal worker Cecily must try to keep the peace and uncover the truth behind a mysterious creature that has begun terrorizing the community.
Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.
A horror aficionado begins to teach an unsuspecting applicant the rules of his video store, but is soon suspected of something sinister.
Entertainment, Mystery, Comedy, Fantasy, Science fiction, Thriller
A married crime novelist finds himself in a tough predicament when an eccentric mystic summons the spirit of his first wife during a séance.
Cassie is a single mother and real estate agent whose problems go from bad to worse when a disgruntled client kidnaps her.

Arthur Blake (Dominic Monaghan) is about to be executed by guillotine for the crime of grave robbing. But before he faces the blade, he agrees to confess to Father Duffy (Ron Perlman) in the hope that the priest might be merciful enough to spare his life. Arthur tells his life story to the priest, which begins with him stealing valuables from the deceased as a youth. But as he relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls, his tale takes a turn for the supernatural.
A struggling rock musician finds himself in a living nightmare when he accidentally kills the neighbor from hell.
A couple's (Alice Lowe, Steve Oram) cross-country road trip takes a deadly turn when they decide to start killing everyone who annoys them.
Residents of an island off the coast of Ireland learn that the only way to survive an invasion of blood-sucking aliens is to stay drunk.
Set at an institute devoted to culinary and alimentary performance, a collective finds itself embroiled in power struggles, artistic vendettas and gastrointestinal disorders.
Corinna Mozo brings Cuban ingredients to the Chef's Fridge round; Hugh Acheson challenges the last two cooks to create a restaurant-worthy dish inspired by the American South.
The cooks try to think outside the box to create a dish from Rob Feenie's fridge; making sauce the star in a restaurant-worthy dish for the $10,000 win.
A French Clafoutis has the chefs intrigued; peanut butter is revealed in Chef Steve Hodge's pantry; in the final round, the last two home bakers must make a sandwich dessert.
Madam Goldie challenges her drag queen mother, Juicy, to take on So Yummy's banana split cake.
Moroccan bream; couscous salad; pomegranate and harissa; British burgers; shred salad; pickles and things.
Jamie makes jerk pork, grilled corn and crunchy tortilla salad, minestrone, poached chicken and salsa verde.

Raymond Blanc shares nostalgic dishes from his childhood, including vegetable soup three ways and a special assiette of salads; Nathan Outlaw visits and treats Raymond to his childhood favorite: fish and chips with mushy peas and tartar sauce.
Adriano Zumbo puts 12 amateur dessert makers to the test; contestants must make a dessert that best reflects them.
The amateur cooks are tasked with bringing a "Franken-Zumbo" to life.
Following a chocolate-themed challenge, two contestants face a Zumbo Test involving 100 handmade profiteroles.
The remaining dessert makers must take their favorite Arnott's biscuit and turn it into an amazing new dessert.

Silvia shines a light on these homemade customs for what they truly are, sensible alternatives to processed food, which place Italian families firmly in control of what they eat; the art of breathing fresh life into leftovers is one of the valuable things Silvia's mother ever taught her; to prove it, after cooking a zucchini pasta, Silvia and her mother reinvent the leftovers as a delicious spaghetti frittata.

Food writer and home cook Silvia Colloca feels most Italian when she is in her kitchen; she bakes with her mother and cooks for her family from a treasured dowry of Italian home cooking know-how passed on from generations of Nonnas and Mammas.
Diana takes inspiration from her Malaysian roots, exploring traditional flavors by cooking an authentic Nonya laksa lemak with the help of her cousin.
Diana turns to Chef Jerry Mai to explore the integral flavors of Cambodian cuisine, as they cook Nam Banh Chok, Kampot Pepper Vongole and Nhom Krauch Thlong.
Anna discusses the versatility of pancakes and prepares them three different ways.
Anna makes a basic crème anglaise and uses it to make three desserts.
Contestants use beets in the elimination round; the two remaining contestants compete in a spring-themed cake final showdown.
Bakers take on figs in the elimination round and a princess theme in the cupcake showdown.
Great pork starts with how the animal is raised; Jenn learns about pork production and enjoys a true farm to table dinner.
Jenn picks fresh tomatoes at an organic vegetable farm before trying a tomato-based cocktail and a delectable meal starring the bright red fruit.
In Inukjuak, one of the largest communities in Nunavik, Chuck learns all about seal hunting; for local residents, seal and caribou are the two main sources of food.

In Mattagami, Chuck meets Betty Naveau, a community member who shares knowledge and traditions with the younger generation; they take a trip to the woods to harvest medicinal plants and visit a hatchery that preserves the lake's fish population.
Flaky pastry pesto chicken; spicy nduja vongole; surf and turf pasta; sausage bake; watermelon granita.
Jamie cooks crispy duck and hoisin lettuce parcels, chicken cacciatore, and spaghetti and smoky tomato sauce.
Derren follows Lou Gentile, a top American ghost hunter who, for 20 years, has been helping rid the haunted and possessed of America of their unwanted ghostly companions.

The venue for this edition is Momma Cherri's Soul Food Shack, an intimate 40-seater a stone's throw from Brighton's sea front. Owner Charita Jones produces a menu of irresistibly unique classics from the Deep South.

The venue for the fourth programme is La Riviera, a fine dining restaurant in Inverness. Owned by multi-millionaire Barry Larson and costing £8,000 a week to run, the place boasts top French chef Loïc Lefebvre and an impeccably-trained kitchen staff with Michelin star-studded backgrounds. Loïc is on a mission to bring sophisticated French cooking to the home of haggis, tatties and deep-fried Mars bars.

Clubway 41 in Blackpool is a 40-seater restaurant above a café, both owned and run by David Jackson and his partner Dawn Brindley. Despite being voted Blackpool Tourist Board's Restaurant of the Year, Clubway 41 is in dire straits. David and Dawn are breaking all the cardinal rules for running a successful food business; in fact, there are no rules, and it shows.
This episode's venue is Irish family-run restaurant Oscars in Nantwich, Cheshire, run by Maura - who also heads up the front-of-house team - and her son and head chef Lenin.

The venue for this programme is Sandgate in Kent, where husband and wife team Lois and Peter Hamilton-Slade own and run a small English seaside hotel. They enjoy eating in restaurants and thought it would be fun to own one, so they pooled their life savings with no previous experience in the industry. Here, there's chaos in the kitchen as first-time head chef Stuart struggles with the demands of each menu.

The programme visits La Gondola in Derby, a hotel and restaurant owned and run by businesswoman Daniela Bayfield. In the past La Gondola was the toast of Derby, reaching the height of its reputation in the 1970s and early 1980s, but the glory days are long gone, and La Gondola is sinking fast. The restaurant's decor, staff and food are all stuck in the past.
Derren tries to take control of the nation by having viewers become stuck to their sofas.
Derren tests viewers' ability to see a hidden object.
In Derren's ambitious final Event, will he win one viewer £175,000 as he puts a member of the public's savings at stake on a genuine roulette wheel?
Derren Brown turns himself into the host of a game show and investigates whether we all have the capacity for evil and whether being part of a group affects our sense of right and wrong.

Derren Brown asks and answers a single question, featuring an inventive and jaw-dropping mixture of stunts, magic, illusion, suggestion and thought-provoking entertainment, combined with tried and tested psychological experiments to illustrate how easily our behaviour can be manipulated. In the first episode, Derren Brown investigates hypnosis and asks if someone could be hypnotised into killing a celebrity.

Derren investigates what makes some people lucky and others attract only misfortune. This episode takes the form of a documentary fronted by Dawn Porter, who acts as Derren's secret agent, and this time the subject of the experiment is an entire town. Together, Dawn and Derren plant a rumour about the lucky powers of a local statue and watch as it changes the lives of the residents.

Derren Brown investigates what it would take for someone to admit to a murder they didn't commit. An unwitting participant finds himself at the centre of a murder mystery - can Derren convince him to admit to a murder he didn't commit?

Illusionist Derren Brown stars in this programme in which he plans to execute the perfect crime. He has bet renowned art collector Ivan Massow that he can steal a painting from right under his nose - telling Massow which art piece he is targeting, what time the theft will happen and who is going to take it. To help pull off the theft, Brown recruits a crew of old-age pensioners, who tend to slip by unnoticed in society. The entertainer teaches the seniors the skills needed to complete the theft, including how to move together with perfect synchronicity and timing, before the show's finale; the team's attempt to steal the painting - a work by brothers Jake and Dinos Chapman - under nearly impossible conditions.

Derren Brown has a system for winning at the horses. The maestro of mind control anonymously tells a single mum from London which horse will win at the next day's races - again and again - culminating in a final, massive bet. Investigating the psychology behind gambling and using his unique combination of skills to create guaranteed wins, Derren proves his system works every time.

Derren Brown's critically acclaimed show returns for a second series. In the opening show of the new series, Derren ambushes Glen, a father of two, who agrees to compete in a Night of the Champions pub quiz, where the top teams from all over London will be gathered. Derren has a week in which to convince Glen that he has a greater memory capacity than he first thought and 'train' him for the big night.

Derren demonstrates the power of negative suggestion by taking 19-year-old Lauren on an emotional rollercoaster to see if, having been told not to, she can resist killing a kitten, which is in a metal box wired up to the mains electricity. Along the way, Derren makes a seasoned circus performer fall off the high-wire and a group of schoolchildren succumb to temptation while being observed on hidden cameras.

Agency worker Angela is ambushed by Derren in total blackout in an office. Over the next few weeks, she is given a number of tasks to fulfil, both physical and mental, to ensure she is ready to face probably the most challenging experience of her life. She is to be kidnapped and subjected to a terrifying ordeal and will have to use psychological techniques, given to her by Derren, to escape her predicament.

Derren attempts to transform IT worker Jason from a nervous doubter to a confident go-getter by teaching him a number of life-enhancing techniques that unlock the secrets of powerful confidence. Derren has Jason experience a potentially embarrassing speed-dating event - twice - and has one final surprise in store.
Experience the power of superstition as Derren executes one final twist on all the previous participants, including David Tennant, who have arrived for the end of series wrap party.

Derren Brown hits the road to find out if some of the more extraordinary claims from around the world are actually true. He starts off by travelling to Liverpool to investigate the world of Joe Power, a psychic medium who claims he can communicate with the dead. Joe alleges that one of the many people he has made contact with is Liverpool's own John Lennon.

Derren travels to Holland with Judy Dunk, a British lady who has been blind since 1995. Both Derren and Judy are intrigued by the claims made by Vyacheslav Bronnikov, the founder of the Bronnikov method, a psychic programme that has its eyes set on world domination. Critics say it is fakery but practitioners say it is an extraordinary psychic method that enables you to see without using your eyes.
Derren tries to convince one person that the planet has been devastated by a meteor.

The unwitting participant continues his adventure in a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by the infected. Meticulously crafted challenges and situations begin to transform his way of seeing himself and his life, as he goes towards a thrilling climax.
Derren Brown presents an experiment to eradicate people's fears through the use of a powerful drug. He attempts to show he can really help the participants to conquer their afflictions.
Derren Brown looks at the psychology of religious belief, performs a satanic rite and attempts to give an atheist a religious conversion.
Derren takes one individual on an unbelievable personal journey in which they face their greatest fears. Can they rise to Derren's life-changing challenge?

Sonic outsmarts Coconuts, then stumbles into a Convention of Bounty Hunter Robots where Robotnik puts a price on his head. After Sonic defeats all the Robot Bounty Hunters, Robotnik creates Scratch and Grounder to be his S.S.S.S.S. Squad.
Sonic and Tails head into a network of abandoned mine shafts to escape Scratch and Grounder.
Sonic saves a hedgehog girl, Breezie, from Scratch and Grounder, and falls for her; Breezie is truly a robot created by Robotnik to exterminate Sonic.

Dr. Robotnik invented a ray gun that's supposed to slow Sonic down for good; a family of sloths comes under attack from Scratch and Grounder, who use them to lure Sonic into the path of the Doc's ray.
Robotnik is in need of workers to build a huge monument of himself for Robotnik Day; he opens up the new Casino Night Zone to get gamblers to lose everything and have to work for him.
A popular cartoonist Sketch Lampoon is imprisoned in Robotnik's prison.
Warpnik escapes from the Zone of Confusion and seeks revenge.
Sonic and Tails try to help a pair of Aliens repair their ship before the Prince's baby brother destroys earth.

Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.
While Coconuts is permanent vacation, he runs into Boom-Boom, a long-lost Gorilla who thinks Coconuts is his father; Coconuts and Boom-Boom team to capture Sonic.
After a song about Sonic becomes popular, Robotnik bans music.
Princess Sally and Antoine follow up on a lead that suggests her father, King Acorn, may be alive; Sonic attempts to rescue a captured Freedom Fighter.
Sally is taken prisoner by Robotnik and Snively, who construct a robotized Sally clone.
Sonic and the Freedom Fighters travel to Robotnik's lab hoping to decipher his Roboticizer system.
Sonic and the Freedom Fighters look for the secret scrolls that have great powers.
Sonic and Sally encounter the Guardian while on a mission to the big city to replace Nicole's malfunctioning microchip.

While on a mission to the big city to replace Nicole's malfunctioning microchip, Sonic and Sally encounter the Guardian, a mysterious cloaked figure who guards a dormant wizard named Lazar and his computer of evil spells.
Sonic conquers a vehicle designed to locate and destroy living tissue matter during a solo mission to the Badlands.
Sonic defeats Robotnik's vehicle, which is designed to locate living tissue, during a mission to the Badlands; when Sonic returns, the Freedom Fighters hold a social gathering for him.
When Sally uncovers Robotnik's plan to seed the clouds with toxic rain, they attempt a mission to sabotage it.
Robotnik makes an announcement that he and Queen Aleena will be wed so he can become king of Mobius.
A captain of the Queen's guard is captured before he can reach the secret rendezvous where he was to meet Queen Aleena.

Este fue el único caso de licantropía clínica documentado y el primer asesino en serie de nuestra historia. El médico forense más prestigioso de nuestro país contará la razón por la que sigue buscando los restos de Manuel Blanco Romasanta.

La serie se adentra en los asesinatos que tuvieron un gran impacto en España desde el siglo XIX hasta la actualidad. El programa nos sumergirá en la investigación policial, además de mostrarnos la experiencia emocional de los afectados.

Near the end of the Civil War, Julia Hayne (Miriam Hopkins) travels to Libby Prison to convince Cmdr. Vance Irby (Randolph Scott) to help transport gold from Virginia City to the South. Union intelligence agent Kerry Bradford (Errol Flynn) breaks out of the prison and, learning of the plot for the gold, travels to Nevada, meeting Julia on the way. Sensing Julia is attracted to Kerry, Vance asks her to help set a trap while desperados led by Murrell (Humphrey Bogart) also close in on the gold.

When Southern belle Susanna Drake (Elizabeth Taylor) visits Indiana, she falls for John Wickliff Shawnessy (Montgomery Clift), an abolitionist with strong ideals. However, John falters while he lets Drake tempt him away from his true love, Nell Gaither (Eva Marie Saint). After Drake deceives John into marriage, the two move to her New Orleans household, where he discovers that mental illness runs in her family. When the Civil War begins, John uses it to escape from the unhappy marriage.

Famous author "Kit" Masterson (Claudette Colbert) needs an actor to portray the lead character, a soldier, in the upcoming movie version of her book. While on a train to California, she meets Marine Rusty Thomas (John Wayne) and his friend, Dink (Don DeFore). She begins to imagine the macho Rusty as the lead, and attempts to stay in his company. However, since Rusty did not like her book, Kit must conceal her identity, all the while growing more attracted to her potential actor.

A renowned gunslinger with a storied past, Tom Horn (Steve McQueen) opts for a reclusive life until he starts working for rancher John C. Coble (Richard Farnsworth). Though Horn begins seeing pretty local teacher Glendolene Kimmel (Linda Evans), he remains restless. Investigating livestock theft, Horn is brutal when dealing with criminals, and while his presence is initially appreciated, eventually the community grows concerned about the enforcer's violent methods.

Pregnant nineteen-year old Marie Allen (Eleanor Parker) is sentenced to prison as an accessory to robbery. The warden, Ruth Benton (Agnes Moorehead), dedicated to reforming even the most hardened of the prisoners, deals fairly with Marie, even upon learning of her condition. The naïve Marie comes up against tough block matron Evelyn Harper (Hope Emerson) and must decide whether accepting the friendship of the toughest prisoners will rub off on her and affect the future of her unborn child.

Fleet-footed Colin Smith (Tom Courtenay) is a rebellious teenager in the poverty-stricken town of Nottingham, in northern England, who enjoys running as an escape from his harsh reality. Caught stealing cash from a bakery, Colin is sent to a reform school where the manipulative governor (Michael Redgrave) promotes sports as rehabilitation by enlisting Colin in a foot race against a prestigious rival school. What the governor doesn't realize is that Colin is not so easily disciplined.

Frank Ross (James Cagney) is an intrepid reporter hot on the trail of a corrupt politician when he is framed for vehicular manslaughter and sent to prison. There he meets the infamous gangster "Hood" Stacey (George Raft), and the two become fast friends when Stacey saves Ross from a deadly knife attack. When Stacey escapes from a courthouse, he promises that he will help clear Ross' name by finding the man who framed him. But can Ross really trust the word of a gangster?

When King Richard the Lionheart is captured, his scheming brother Prince John (Claude Rains) plots to reach the throne, to the outrage of Sir Robin of Locksley (Errol Flynn), the bandit king of Sherwood Forest. Rounding up his band of men and eventually winning the support of the lovely Maid Marian (Olivia de Havilland), Robin accuses Prince John of treachery and, when the escaped Richard returns covertly to England, joins forces with the king to prevent Prince John from taking the crown.

A trumpet player in a radio orchestra (Jack Benny) falls asleep during a commercial and dreams he's the angel Athanael. The beautiful angel Elizabeth (Alexis Smith) delivers Athanael to the head of heaven's orchestra, where he's told to return to earth and blow his trumpet at midnight, thus marking the end of the world. When he fails his assignment, he becomes a fallen angel, and though he's given a second chance, his fellow fallen angels conspire to keep him from completing his mission.

Ivan Igor (Lionel Atwill) is the sculptor at a famous wax museum in London. When his partner, Joe Worth (Edwin Maxwell), burns down the museum for the insurance money, Igor is trapped inside. Years later he re-emerges in New York as the curator of a new wax museum, which boasts incredibly lifelike statues. When model Joan Gale (Monica Bannister) goes missing, however, reporter Florence Dempsey (Glenda Farrell) follows the clues to Igor's museum, where she discovers a terrible secret.

Ralph Willart (Karl Malden) and his wife Annabell (Angela Lansbury) are constantly at odds over what to do with their son, Berry-Berry (Warren Beatty). While Annabell treats him like a saint, Ralph is more keen on his boy's womanizing ways. Berry-Berry's younger brother Clint (Brandon de Wilde) idolizes him despite what his father says, but when Berry-Berry develops a relationship with family friend Echo O'Brien (Eva Marie Saint), Clint discovers just how shallow his older brother is.

In Berlin in 1931, American cabaret singer Sally Bowles (Liza Minnelli) meets British academic Brian Roberts (Michael York), who is finishing his university studies. Despite Brian's confusion over his sexuality, the pair become lovers, but the arrival of the wealthy and decadent playboy Maximilian von Heune (Helmut Griem) complicates matters for them both. This love triangle plays out against the rise of the Nazi party and the collapse of the Weimar Republic.

Testing his theory that in every man dwells a good and an evil force, the reserved Dr. Jekyll (Fredric March) develops a formula that separates the two, turning him into a violent ruffian named Mr. Hyde. Thinking he has found the answer to one of life's grandest mysteries, Dr. Jekyll soon realizes he is becoming addicted to his darker self as he unleashes his violent side on earthy dance hall girl Ivy (Miriam Hopkins) and fights Hyde to regain control of his body.

Left untreated, hoarding can destroy the lives of the person afflicted and their loved ones. This series shines a light on the serious condition, with each hourlong episode profiling two extreme hoarders struggling to fight the need to collect things and return to a more normal life. Therapists and organizers help the hoarders attempt to find what causes their compulsive behavior, but for most the process of decluttering and organizing becomes an extremely difficult task.

Gros and Wynn-Grant travel the country to explore how human activity impacts animal behavior and share how modern science, technology and other conservation techniques can help save North America's imperiled wildlife, one species at a time.
