Wolfe discovers that some people will stop at nothing to close a deal, even married men.
Desperate for a child, a woman hires Wolfe to find out whether her husband is cheating.
Wolfe tracks newlywed to San Diego, where his wife thinks he's cheating with an old college flame.
A woman thinks her boyfriend might have another woman; a turn of events has Wolfe questioning the investigation.
A man is suspicious of his attractive girlfriend, who goes "off the grid" on occasion.
A small business owner suspects his secretary of stealing supplies, but she might be a victim.
Julie suspects her fellow recovering alcoholic Kay has fallen off the wagon; Wolfe investigates and finds it worse than Julie fears.
A wife hires Wolfe to see if her husband is gambling away their money, but she becomes part of his investigation.
A woman diagnosed with cancer finds a man with cancer through his blog, but he may be too good to be true.
Private investigator Brian Wolfe brings to light a shocking surprise when a client hires him to find out if his electrician is sleeping on the job.
A psychic enlists Wolfe when she suspects her husband of cheating, but it goes way beyond infidelity.
A battered young woman awakes to find she is being blackmailed by someone who threatens to post nude pictures of her online unless she pays him a large amount of money.
A man who met his fiancée at Alcoholics Anonymous hires private investigator Brian Wolfe to find out why her behavior has changed.
Private investigators Brian Wolfe and Lisa Perez go undercover at a beachfront boutique resort to find the thief who is stealing from the resort's VIP clients.
A woman hires private investigator Brian Wolfe to find out whether her son is having a romantic relationship with his young teacher.
As cult leader Jim Jones becomes increasingly unhinged and despotic, teenagers Vernon and Leslie take desperate measures to escape from Jonestown, Guyana.
Troubled teenager Angela King becomes a white supremacist who preaches hate and launches attacks against innocent victims, then she goes to prison for armed robbery and tries to find redemption.
Librarian Sarah Rose abandons her family to go on the road with a spiritual teacher, then the journey turns into a nightmare as she suffers violence at the hands of her guru, "Master David."
When Maura Schmierer joins a Christian group, she becomes trapped in a militaristic regime that destroys her marriage and separates her from her children.
In 1975, Janja Lalich joins the San Francisco-based Democratic Workers Party and soon finds herself caught up in a web of abuse.
Married family man Dr. Adam Frasch has a booming practice, and he loves to spend money on houses, automobiles and exotic dancers; ultimately, the doctor will reap what he sows in deceit and jealousy.
Temptress Cathy Cousin moves in next door to devoted family man Tim Koile, wrapping him around her finger and convincing him to satisfy her every whim no matter how diabolical.
Lyle and Carol Kopenskey are high school sweethearts who marry after graduation; after 40 years of marriage, one of them becomes involved in an extra-marital affair that leads to cold-blooded murder.
Valuing wealth more than love, Michelle Donohue casts aside good men before meeting Mr. Right who gives her a taste of her own medicine and sends her down a murderous path.
In Garden Grove, Calif., 19-year-old Jose Najera sneaks out of his parents' house to attend a late-night party, then he returns home to find both parents dead on their bedroom floor.
Janet Lynn Mickey dreams of starting her own family and marries college football star Darrell Tyburski; plans change after the young couple begins having children, leading them down a very dark path.
Terror strikes during a young family's evening stroll in La Mirada, Calif.; nothing seems to add up during the criminal investigation, with the truth taking years to emerge.
Single mother Rainey Morin meets soul mate Robert Kowalski who treats her like a queen; however, beneath Kowalski's kind veneer is a dark history that threatens to wreak havoc.
After losing her husband in a tragic accident, a God-fearing Cindy McKay claims she has to bend the law to pay off his illicit debts; authorities soon realize that McKay is a criminal mastermind.

George Kalomeris is a family man who looks after the less fortunate in his community. Then a dying man fingers Kalomeris as the shooter, and police discover a monster more diabolical than anyone could ever imagine possible.

In 2015, Detective Scott Sanderson finds himself investigating one of the strangest cases of his career, involving a missing woman and her newborn; before long, he uncovers a diabolical scheme that will destroy the lives of everyone it touches.

A cold morning in December starts off like any other, then a farmer finds the body of a dead woman; what seems like a rape and murder case turns into a conspiracy, and someone's diabolical nature is soon revealed.
On April 17, 2015, a Virginia hunter makes a grisly discovery in the woods; he finds a woman with an execution-style gun shot wound to the back of her head.

Gina Coccia comes home from work to discover the bodies of her girlfriend, Lynn, and Lynn's nephew, Ronnie, shot and stabbed on the kitchen floor; the investigation leads police to a terrifying act of betrayal.

In Susanville, Calif., a beloved police officer is found dead in what looks like an apparent suicide, then detectives launch a full-blown murder investigation and zero in on the officer's wife as a possible suspect.

Donna Scrivo hasn't seen her adult son, Ramsay, in days, and she's worried; she alerts the police, but days pass with no sign of him anywhere; then the discovery of a severed head and body parts along a highway reveals an act of shocking violence.
Penny Knell is admitted to a special care facility, where a devious mastermind is waiting to prey on vulnerable people; when Penny's family gets ensnared in her web, the consequences will be fatal.
In Prichard, Ala., loving father Re'Mano Campbell is found murdered in his home; it takes the cunning wit of local investigators to unravel the mystery of who murdered him.
After Cynthia Roth drowns in the middle of a crowded lake, investigators uncover a decades-long trail of terror; detectives must take extraordinary measures to catch the killer.

After her home is invaded and her husband murdered, Shaunna Dodd recounts her harrowing ordeal at gunpoint; however, when investigators dig deeper, they uncover a tale of lies, infidelity and shady characters who have wandered into the Washoe Valley.

In early 1980, two eerily similar crimes occur 400 miles apart; they both leave young mother dead and an infant child stolen; years later, police unravel a plot so cold-blooded, it leaves everyone even seasoned homicide detectives in utter shock.

A burning car is found by the side of a highway on the same night a single mother of two is reported missing; the two events are related and connecting the dots leads investigators to a notorious criminal who has been hiding in plain sight.
Air Force veteran Michael Giles disappears along with his savings of $206,000 and detectives find that Kwaneta Harris has been draining his accounts.

In 1994, Lake Orion, Mich., is rocked by a murder; at first, the crime is a mystery -- but in a small town where everyone knows each other, rumors start flying; police soon expose a strange and twisted plot that no one saw coming.

In Las Vegas, a beloved father of four is found dead in his car; he's been bound, gagged, and asphyxiated; witnesses lead detectives to a local man named John Brian Ray, but this troubled man is just a pawn in the game of a criminal mastermind.

Three men die over a span of a dozen years, with no suspicion of wrongdoing and no files charged; but when a deadly car explosion rips through downtown Pensacola, Fla., a new investigation begins; all suspicion points toward just one person.
